10-b-criminal-law-center-st-catharines:
10(B) Criminal Law Center is a Niagara criminal defence practice handling bail hearings, trials, youth court and impaired driving charges.

The office is in St. Catharines, and the site says the practice is exclusively criminal defence led by Sidney Zarabi. Listed areas include bail hearings, resolution and diversion, youth criminal justice, mental health and drug treatment court, Indigenous peoples court and trials. The firm also describes helping clients reach counselling, housing and employment programs. Zarabi has written commentary on Niagara's justice system, including its detention centre and treatment court, and the firm notes membership in the Ontario Trial Lawyers Association.
a-dhillon-law-brampton:
A Dhillon Law is a Brampton criminal defence firm serving clients in Toronto, Mississauga and across Southern Ontario.

The firm is led by Akash Dhillon, who holds an Hons B.A. and J.D. Its site refers to charges such as sexual assault and impaired driving, and its blog covers identity fraud in Milton, disobeying a court order in Orangeville and youth charges in Ontario. It notes that a criminal charge can affect freedom, immigration status, career and travel, and says each case gets a defence strategy based on the evidence. Flexible payment plans are listed.
a-m-canadian-immigration-law-corporation:
A&M Canadian Immigration Law Corporation is a Winnipeg firm handling study permits, work permits, Express Entry, family sponsorships and citizenship matters. The firm was founded by Dr. Muhammad Abrar, a barrister and solicitor with a PhD in law from Glasgow University who says he began practising law in 2005.

Its site lists study permit extensions, post-graduation work permits, LMIA work permits, visitor visas, the Super Visa, provincial nominations including all Manitoba Provincial Nominee Program streams, the Rural Community Immigration Program, spousal sponsorships and proof of citizenship. It also covers procedural fairness letters, refusals and reconsideration, appeals and Federal Court litigation, and mentions U.S. immigration. The firm serves clients across Canada and internationally.
a-s-law-office-winnipeg:
This Winnipeg, Manitoba law office at 1785 Main Street is listed as A.S. Law Office and is associated with real estate and family law.

No further details about the office's lawyers, services or approach were available from its website when this profile was prepared, so this entry is limited to the firm's name, location and listed practice areas.
achkar-law:
Achkar Law is a North York employment law firm acting for employees and employers in Ontario and British Columbia on dismissal, severance and human rights.

Christopher Achkar founded the firm in 2016, and his letter on the site says he wanted to practise in plain language, with practical strategies, for real people facing real problems. The firm also handles constructive dismissal, workplace disputes and employer-side defence, with a hub for Toronto and the GTA. For employers, its lawyers design workplace training, including on the harassment and violence requirements under Ontario's Occupational Health and Safety Act. The site says the firm acts on either side of an employment dispute.
addelman-baum-gilbert-llp-ottawa:
Addelman Baum Gilbert LLP is an Ottawa firm handling criminal defence and child protection (C.A.S.) proceedings across Eastern Ontario.

The firm was formed in January 2010 by Richard Addelman, Douglas Baum, Jason Gilbert and Joseph Addelman. Based in Ottawa, it says it also serves Brockville, Cornwall, L'Orignal, Perth, Pembroke, Renfrew and Smiths Falls. It acts in criminal and regulatory offences as well as child protection cases, and describes trial and appellate work on matters such as homicides. Its site notes that Richard Addelman graduated from the University of Ottawa Faculty of Law in 1969 and helped found the Defence Counsel Association of Ottawa in 1975.
aftermath-law-criminal-defence-mississau:
Aftermath Law is a Mississauga criminal defence practice led by Dildeep Sahi, handling assault, domestic assault and sexual assault charges in Peel Region.

According to its website, Dildeep Sahi trained at an Ontario Crown Attorney's Office and the firm takes urgent matters around the clock. Charges listed include assault with a weapon or causing bodily harm and aggravated assault. The site says it serves thirteen Ontario communities, including Brampton, from its Mississauga office, and that it accepts Legal Aid and offers flat fees. Its structured data lists English, Punjabi and Hindi, and its pages explain how release conditions, a record, travel and immigration status can be affected by a charge.
agir-legal-inc: Agir Legal Inc is listed as a family law firm in Quebec City, Quebec. Its office is at 1020 Rue Bouvier, Suite 400, Quebec City, Quebec G2K 0H3. No website was available for this firm when the entry was prepared, so its lawyers, services beyond the family law practice tag and approach are not described here.
agp-llp-ottawa-criminal-lawyers-ottawa:
AGP LLP is an Ottawa criminal defence firm of trial and appellate lawyers handling appeals, assault, drinking and driving, drug and homicide cases.

The firm says it was founded in Ottawa two decades ago and describes a custom-crafted defence for each client. Its practice areas include bail hearings, domestic assaults, sexual assault and white-collar matters, and it acts for executives, civil servants, doctors, pharmacists, high-tech workers, diplomats and organizations facing criminal or regulatory issues. A separate appeals page explains that criminal appeals turn on finding legal errors, and says the firm defends against Crown appeals from acquittal or sentence and takes referrals from other lawyers.
ain-whitehead-llp-barrie:
Ain Whitehead LLP is a Barrie firm handling business, real estate and wills and estates law.

The site marks ten years of the practice and names lawyers Andrew Ain, Graydon Ebert, Jill Annett, Kathryn Whitehead and Tony Servello. Andrew's work centres on residential real estate, mortgage lending and commercial transactions, with a focus on land development and condominium law, plus corporate matters such as new corporations, shareholder agreements and the buying and selling of businesses. Real estate pages cover commercial leasing, lease negotiation and drafting, and include a land transfer calculator. Areas mentioned include the City of Barrie and the Township of Springwater.
aird-berlis-llp:
Aird & Berlis LLP is a Toronto business law firm, with a Vancouver office, advising on corporate, capital markets and real estate matters.

Founded in 1919 according to its site data, the firm acts for multinational corporations, startups, individuals, governments and Indigenous nations. Its listed areas include Aboriginal law, projects and infrastructure, restructuring and insolvency, intellectual property, municipal and land use planning, tax, technology and workplace law. Recent items include a Workplace Law Summit scheduled for November 12, 2026 in Toronto and a Wolters Kluwer book on international relocation and tax planning for high-net-worth individuals.
aitken-robertson-kingston:
Aitken Robertson's Kingston office defends criminal charges, including impaired driving, sexual assault, domestic assault and internet offences.

The firm describes a team approach in which every criminal lawyer takes an active role in each case, with a pool of seven lawyers working on a file. It states combined experience of more than 100 years and says it acts at all court levels in Oshawa, Toronto, Newmarket, Peterborough, Kingston, Markham and elsewhere in Ontario. Flexible fee arrangements are mentioned, and the site publishes a list of myths and facts about impaired driving, covering topics such as blood alcohol readings and the difference between over 80 and impaired charges. The Kingston office is on Princess Street.
aitken-robertson-peterborough:
Aitken Robertson (Peterborough) is a Peterborough criminal defence firm handling impaired driving, sexual assault and domestic assault charges. Its website says the lawyers work as a team, with every criminal lawyer at the firm taking an active part in each file, and cites more than 100 years of combined experience.

The Peterborough office is at 263 Charlotte Street, and the site lists Oshawa, Toronto, Newmarket, Kingston and Markham among the places where it defends charges, at all court levels in Ontario. Richard Aitken is among the lawyers named, and the site also posts a myths-and-facts guide to impaired driving charges in Canada and mentions flexible fee arrangements.
alam-real-estate-law-mississauga:
Alam Real Estate Law is a Mississauga firm handling property purchases, sales, refinancing and real estate litigation in the GTA and Halton.

Principal lawyer Jawaid Alam has degrees in commerce, economics and finance, business management and law, holds Ontario accreditation of his law degree through the National Committee of Accreditation, and speaks English, Hindi and Urdu. The firm also lists construction litigation, registering and removing liens, commercial property development litigation, and examination of agreements of purchase and sale and mortgage agreements. It serves residential and commercial clients across Mississauga and the surrounding communities.
alepin-gauthier-avocats:
Alepin Gauthier Avocats is a family-run Laval firm of lawyers, notaries and tax advisers covering business law, family law, tax and litigation. According to its website, the firm has been in business since 1978 and serves individuals and small and medium businesses.

It says it serves clients across Quebec and internationally through the Law Firm Alliance, with appointments in Laval, Montreal, Quebec City or online at any hour. Its franchise law group assists franchisors and franchisees, including on intellectual property, and its advertising and marketing group advises on promotional contests, signage under the Charter of the French Language, influencer partnerships, anti-spam and privacy rules, and competition law.
alexander-hu-professional-corporation-to:
Alexander Hu Professional Corporation is a Downtown Toronto law firm limited to real estate, handling home and condo purchases, sales and mortgages.

The firm's structured data describes work on title examination, financing and closing coordination, and its pages mention the examination of condominium status certificates and collaboration with realtors and mortgage lenders. It serves Toronto, Peel, Durham, York and Halton regions, with page content on Central Toronto, Old York, East York, Etobicoke, North York and Scarborough. Topics covered include multiple offers, rezoning and development, property taxes, land transfer taxes and mixed-use or commercial properties.
alg-lawyers:
ALG Lawyers is an Abbotsford firm with offices in Surrey and Vancouver, handling family, criminal, civil, real estate and estate litigation matters.

Its head office is on Garden Street in Abbotsford, which the firm says it moved to while welcoming professionals and clients from Bronson Jones Gray & Company. Practice areas include appeals and a detailed adoption service covering step-parent, relative and kinship, adult, direct placement, agency and ministry, and contested adoptions. The firm describes itself as a paperless office staffed by lawyers and paralegals, and says it serves families across the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley.
align-family-law:
Align Family Law is a Victoria family law firm, with a Kimberley office, handling separation, divorce and marriage and cohabitation agreements.

The firm describes a collaborative approach built around a step-by-step plan, which it calls the Align Method. Its site lists flat-fee services, divorce-only packages, independent legal advice on family law agreements, and says clients choose how much help they want, from assistance with one part of a matter to full representation. The firm says it works with people around British Columbia.
amanda-berloni-professional-corporation:
Amanda Berloni Professional Corporation is a Greater Sudbury practice, founded in 2015, focused on real estate and corporate and commercial law.

According to its website, Amanda Berloni and her team have helped thousands of people with property purchases since 2015, reviewing agreements of purchase and sale, preparing mortgage and loan documents and commercial leases, and advising on title insurance and electronic registration. On the business side, the firm describes helping clients establish, grow and support their companies. The site marks ten years in the community and lists local sponsorships, including a Sudbury Secondary School law bursary, Place des Arts de Sudbury and the Sudbury Wolves.
ambassador-law-corporation-abbotsford:
Ambassador Law Corporation is an Abbotsford firm handling real estate conveyancing, subdivisions, wills and estates, corporate law and notarizations.

The firm says it amalgamated with Terry Sidhu Notarial Services Inc. and serves clients throughout the Fraser Valley. Its real estate group acts on home purchases and sales and changes of mortgage lender, and its subdivision work with municipalities covers rezoning, border realignments and splitting a property into several PIDs. Notarizations include affidavits for BC registries, international documents and real estate transfers; the signer must attend in person with government photo identification. The site cites more than fifteen years in subdivisions and over twenty years overall.
amer-ali-law-ottawa:
Amer Ali Law is a virtual Ontario firm, with Ottawa, Orleans and Toronto listed, that handles real estate closings, incorporations and wills.

The firm describes its model as technology paired with personal service, with documents signed electronically and remotely, or in person when arranged in advance. Its real estate page lists buying and selling, title transfers and survivorship applications, mortgage transactions, mortgage refinancing and debt consolidation, and reviewing the agreement of purchase and sale. It says it acts for homeowners, realtors, lenders and mortgage professionals on residential and commercial properties, and that it has completed thousands of real estate deals.
amica-law-corporation-winnipeg: Amica Law Corporation is listed as a Winnipeg general practice firm, at 226 Osborne Street North, Suite 30. Its website did not load when this entry was compiled, so details of its lawyers, history and services are not included. The listing is limited to the firm's name, address, city and practice area in Manitoba.
amlea-avocats:
Amlea Avocats is a Montreal boutique firm handling business law, taxation, and mergers and acquisitions for entrepreneurs and small businesses. Its website, which also addresses start-ups, describes an approach that combines legal, tax and strategic advice.

Listed services include incorporation, choice of corporate structure, corporate books and registers, share capital and shareholder agreements, and the purchase or sale of businesses, shares or assets, including letters of intent. On the tax side the site mentions planning for growing businesses, salary versus dividend compensation, and setting up holding companies. It says it offers personalized support and availability, and its office is at Place d'Armes.
ammar-law-professional-corporation-winds:
Ammar Law Professional Corporation is a Windsor firm led by Ahmad Ammar handling criminal defence, real estate, personal injury, traffic and wills matters.

Ahmad Ammar is licensed to practise in both Ontario and Michigan. The site lists Criminal Code and drug offences, bail hearings, traffic offences, powers of attorney, wills and estates, notary services, and motor vehicle and personal injury claims, and also mentions immigration. Real estate services cover purchases, sales and refinancing. The firm describes its approach as strategic and aimed at protecting legal rights.
anderson-haak-and-engels-edmonton:
Anderson Haak & Engels is an Edmonton real estate law firm handling home and condo purchases, sales and mortgage refinancing in Alberta.

The site explains that a lawyer is needed in Alberta to transfer title on a purchase or sale, and says the firm brings more than sixty years of experience to that work. Its homepage cites over 45,000 real estate transactions and names partners Kenneth R. Haak and Robert A. Engels. The firm also prepares wills, personal care directives and enduring powers of attorney, and it publishes base fees for each service on its services page.
andrews-donnelly-llp-kingston:
Andrews Donnelly LLP is a Kingston boutique firm handling family law, estate litigation and civil litigation.

The firm describes its dispute resolution services as available in Kingston, Frontenac County, Prince Edward County and surrounding areas, including Brockville, Napanee, Belleville and Picton. Family work covers custody, access, child and spousal support and division of property. Estate litigation covers will challenges, power of attorney disputes, capacity questions and the passing of fiduciary accounts. The site has profiles for lawyers Paul and Whitney, and says fees can be arranged as fixed-fee or project-based billing, hourly engagements, or monthly retainers.
anne-gervais-corbin-avocate:
Anne Gervais-Corbin is a Granby lawyer whose listing describes a practice in family law and youth protection. Her office is at 371 Rue Racine in the Estrie region of Quebec.

The firm's page appears in the Réseau des professionnels du droit du Québec directory, under the title Avocate en droit familial et protection de la jeunesse Granby. The page lists sections for products and services, opening hours and accepted payment methods, but gives no further detail on the types of family or youth matters handled, so the description here is limited to what the listing states.
annette-lefebvre-avocats-montreal:
Annette Lefebvre Avocats is a Montreal firm representing patients and accident victims in medical malpractice and personal injury cases.

The firm's website says it acts only for patients and victims, including in birth injury, spinal cord injury and chiropractic injury claims against doctors, medical institutions, building owners and insurers. It reports more than forty years of experience. Annette Lefebvre is a former intensive care nurse who has spent over thirty years on malpractice and injury suits, and Melissa Lonn has devoted her practice to the same fields, drawing on a background in social work and science. The site lists Montreal, Laval, Longueuil and Brossard among the areas served.
apna-law-llp-burnaby:
Apna Law LLP is a Burnaby firm of trial and appellate lawyers handling family, estate, personal injury and civil disputes.

The firm opened in 2018, serves British Columbia and Alberta, and says its lawyers have more than 40 years of combined experience inside and outside the courtroom. Its name is a Punjabi word loosely meaning ours, which the firm links to community and collaboration. The family law team named on the site includes James Gill, Amanda James, Hannah Gowans and Ingrid Lee, and its family pages explain that an appeal to the Court of Appeal is not a re-hearing of the case. The site also publishes articles, including one on international students and immigration consultants.
avanessy-giordano-llp-north-york:
Avanessy Giordano LLP is a North York boutique personal injury firm representing injured people in Toronto and across Ontario.

The firm says it was founded in 2015 by Michael Giordano and Aline Avanessy, each with more than a decade of personal injury experience at large firms before they opened their own practice. They describe a conservative file load, regular updates for clients and a network of medical and rehabilitation practitioners. A separate page covers medical malpractice, where the site says medical professionals are kept on staff to help identify negligence and support a case through litigation.
aviron-law-professional-corporation-bram:
Aviron Law Professional Corporation is a Brampton firm handling real estate, wills and estate planning, business law, immigration and civil litigation.

Its principal lawyer, Dilvir S. Tatter, holds LL.M. and LL.B. degrees, practises as barrister, solicitor and notary public, and began his career in litigation on contractual disputes. The real estate group acts on residential, commercial and condominium purchases and sales, mortgage refinancing, survivorship applications and title transfers. Its litigation page describes civil disputes from a demand letter through negotiation, mediation and trial, including shareholder and partnership conflicts, failed closings and deposit disputes. Team member Avinash Kaur is also named.
avocat-criminel-montreal-montreal:
Lespérance Avocats, listed as Avocat Criminel Montréal, is a criminal defence firm serving Montreal, Laval, Gatineau and Maniwaki in French and English.

Its site places the main office in Old Montreal near Notre-Dame Basilica, with a second office in Gatineau and meetings in Maniwaki by appointment. The firm acts in criminal cases involving firearms, drugs, violence and domestic violence, and its pages explain offences tied to sexual services and human trafficking. It says it accepts legal aid and describes a collaborative, structured approach to each file, supported by an administrative team that manages communication and case handling.
avocat-maitre-lachance:
Avocat Maitre Lachance is a Repentigny practice covering business, civil, real estate and family law, plus mediation.

According to its website, Me Michel Lachance founded his own firm in Repentigny in 1994, after being admitted to the Barreau du Québec in 1985. He holds a law degree from Université Laval, served as a councillor of the Laurentides-Lanaudière bar from 2008 to 2010 and is an active member of the Chamber of Commerce of the MRC de L'Assomption. His business work includes commercial leases, movable hypothecs, hidden defects, corporate restructuring and insurance disputes, with service offered in French.
avocat-montreal:
Avocat Montreal is a Montreal service of the Devichy firm that lets people speak directly with a lawyer seven days a week, by telephone or online chat. Its website covers civil, family, immigration, business, labour, real estate, construction, tax and criminal law.

The site says the service was created because people needing a lawyer are often in urgent situations, and that the lawyer can give first advice and then refer the matter to a meeting with that lawyer or another in the relevant field. Listed topics include sponsorship, asylum and permanent residence, legal hypothecs and RBQ matters in construction, GST and QST questions involving Revenu Québec, and traffic tickets. The office is at 240 Rue Saint-Jacques.
avocates-paille-grondin: Avocates Paille Grondin is a family law practice in Drummondville, Quebec, with an office at 215 Rue Lindsay. No website is on record for the firm, so the directory entry rests on its name, address and listed practice area of family law. The French name indicates a practice of women lawyers, avocates, though no individual lawyers, services or courts are named.
avocats-laurentides-me-rheaume: Avocats Laurentides - Me Rheaume is a law office at 330 Rue Saint-Georges in Saint-Jerome, in Quebec's Laurentides region. The directory has no practice areas, website or description on record for the firm, so no particular services or courts are stated. The name suggests a practice led by a lawyer named Rheaume serving the Laurentides area.
avocats-rive-sud:
Avocats Rive-Sud is a Brossard firm handling civil and criminal law matters, with an office on Avenue Auteuil.

The firm's site says it guides people through the criminal court process while making sure their fundamental rights are respected, and that it also acts in civil matters. Its civil services are described as advice, drafting, representation and negotiation. The website's title describes the firm as Avocats Rive-Sud, droit civil et droit criminel, and its name points to the South Shore of Montréal as its home area.
avtar-bhangal-mississauga:
Avtar Bhangal practises as Bhangal Law, a Mississauga criminal defence firm handling assaults, impaired driving, fraud, theft and drug charges.

The firm's website says it has over thirty years of courtroom experience between its lawyers. Avtar Bhangal has been a member of the Law Society of Ontario, formerly the Law Society of Upper Canada, since 1994, and Savena Bhangal since 2022. The firm states that it has handled thousands of criminal matters, keeps clients informed about their case, and guides them through the criminal justice process. The office is on Derry Road West in Mississauga, Ontario.
axess-law-toronto:
Axess Law is a Toronto firm that handles home closings online or at the client's home, and also advises small businesses on incorporation and registration.

The site says the firm has focused for over a decade on virtual real estate closings, with a short onboarding process, video signing meetings, in-home signing and status updates. It also mentions closings for Quebec properties. Its business law page covers business names, registration, incorporation and partnerships for small businesses and start-ups, through virtual or in-person appointments in Ontario.
ayoun-law-mississauga:
Ayoun Law is a Mississauga firm handling family law, real estate, immigration, estate planning and civil litigation across the GTA.

Styled Ayoun & Sabeeya LLP, the firm was founded by Ayoun Haroon and Sabeeya Akram in 2018, and a licensed paralegal and notary later joined it for tribunal matters and notarizations. The site lists Landlord and Tenant Board matters, traffic tickets, independent legal advice and notary services alongside its main practice areas. Lawyers advise in English, Urdu, Punjabi and Hindi, with an assistant supporting Polish-speaking clients. Fees are stated openly at $199 per half-hour after an introductory 15-minute intake, and service areas include Brampton, Oakville, Milton and Toronto.
b-and-b-law-greater-sudbury:
B&B Law is a general practice firm in Greater Sudbury that acts for both individuals and businesses.

According to its website, the firm stresses timely communication, transparency and a client-responsive way of working, and it describes itself as a modern firm that makes use of technology. It says it regularly meets with clients over audio-visual platforms such as Zoom. The site lists a set of practice areas, and the office is at 238 Elm Street, Unit 200, in Greater Sudbury, Ontario.
b-kay-law-office-edmonton:
B.Kay Law Office is an Edmonton practice handling immigration law, personal injury and notary services for individuals, families and businesses.

The firm was founded by Bikramjit Singh and says it serves Edmonton's multicultural community, as well as clients across Canada, in English, Punjabi, Hindi and Urdu. Its immigration practice lists Canadian temporary residence programs and admissibility hearings and detention matters. The notary page describes Notary Public and Commissioner for Oaths services in Edmonton and surrounding areas, including affidavits, and tells clients what to bring to an appointment.
badesha-law-criminal-lawyer-brampton-bra:
Badesha Law is a Brampton criminal defence firm representing people charged with assault, DUI, theft, domestic violence and other offences.

The firm is led by founding lawyer Harprit Badesha and senior lawyer Kajol Panchol. It says it acts from the first police involvement through bail hearings and trial, across Brampton, Mississauga, Peel Region and the Greater Toronto Area. Other charges listed include sexual assault, dangerous driving, uttering threats, and theft under and over $5,000. According to the site, fees can be flat or flexible, and the firm describes itself as available around the clock.
badre-law-professional-corporation-ottaw:
Badre Law Professional Corporation is an Ottawa personal injury firm handling car accident claims and other injury cases across Ontario.

The firm says it focuses exclusively on personal injury and accidents, and its team page names founder Daniel Badre alongside lawyers including Michael Adamek, Paul D. Mooney, Alex Elkin, Trevor Tynan and Madona Markaj. It claims over 170 years of combined legal experience among its team. Alex Elkin is described as working in the Ontario courts and before the License Appeal Tribunal. The site also publishes guidance on long-term disability claims, including pre-existing conditions and applications.
bakleh-avocats-and-associes-saint-jerome:
Bakleh Avocats & Associés is a Saint-Jerome firm working in criminal, penal, civil and real estate law, and it also contests traffic tickets.

Its website explains that the team helps drivers keep their demerit points and their licence when a ticket is contested, including tickets issued in Montreal. The firm also runs an immigration practice that pairs Me Charlis Bakleh with regulated immigration consultant Joseph Zakhour for study permits, work visas, permanent residence and status regularization, in Quebec, Ontario or remotely. Real estate law is listed among its practice areas. The site is in French.
balance-law-professional-corporation:
Balance Law Professional Corporation is a Niagara Falls firm founded in 2024 that handles tax, corporate, employment, estate and real estate matters.

The firm says it was started to take the mystery out of tax, corporate and commercial law and real estate for clients at every financial level. It describes work on CRA audits, tax controversy, international tax planning and transfer pricing, incorporations through mergers and acquisitions, estate plans and property closings, and says it represents clients before the Federal Court of Canada. The lawyer who leads it is described as holding CPA and LLM qualifications, with earlier experience at RSM, PwC and KPMG. Its clients are small business owners, individuals and families, and property buyers and sellers.
barapp-law-calgary-personal-injury-lawye:
Barapp Law Calgary Personal Injury Lawyers handles car accident, slip and fall and other injury cases for people in Calgary, Alberta.

The firm says it serves the Calgary area exclusively and presents itself as Barapp Law Alberta, a member of the Barapp Law Alliance. Its practice pages cover car accidents, orthopaedic injuries, slip and fall accidents, motorcycle accidents, public transit accidents, pedestrian accidents and dog bite incidents. Separate pages on its site explain each type of injury case and describe what a case assessment involves, and the firm says it takes calls from injured people at any hour.
barapp-law-firm-and-associates-ottawa:
Barapp Law Firm and Associates is a personal injury practice in Nepean, near Ottawa, also serving Grimsby and Timmins.

The firm calls itself a member of the Barapp Law Alliance and lists car accidents, orthopaedic injuries, slip and fall, motorcycle, public transit and pedestrian cases. Eric Barapp, a graduate of Osgoode Hall Law School, leads a team that also names Lorne Weinstock, Eti Taylor, Nabeel Sera, Michael Brill, Albert Wong and Aurora Mancuso. According to its site, each client has a case manager who stays involved throughout, and fees are payable only if the case succeeds.
barbarian-law:
Barbarian Law is an Aurora transactional firm handling real estate closings, corporate work, wills and notary services across York Region.

The firm, based at 14981 Yonge Street, says one lawyer handles each file from start to finish. Its site lists residential and commercial closings, incorporations, shareholder agreements, mergers and acquisitions, and wills with powers of attorney. It states that a written fee estimate comes before work begins, fees are published online, and invoices follow delivery with no deposit. Its listed service area includes Aurora, Richmond Hill, Newmarket and Vaughan, and its structured data names English and Persian as languages. Lawyer Karim Eshqoor also writes commentary on how Canadian law societies regulate law-firm ownership.
barriston-llp:
Barriston LLP is a full-service Barrie firm serving Central Ontario in business, real estate, wills and estates, family law and litigation.

The firm has offices in Barrie, Collingwood, Bracebridge and Huntsville, and its site reports more than 40 lawyers. A municipal group acts for municipalities across Central Ontario as well as for developers and landowners. The firm's blog covers legal developments such as a Manitoba court decision on Indigenous self-government in child and family services, procedural questions in Aboriginal title litigation, and the Indian Act's enfranchisement provisions. It also lists community support among its activities.
barrou-nadia-montreal:
Barrou Nadia is a Montreal immigration law practice handling temporary visas, permanent residence, sponsorship and citizenship applications.

The firm says it has worked in Canadian immigration law since 1998, with a team of lawyers and consultants. Its site lists applications for foreign students, temporary workers, permanent residents, sponsored family members, visitors and prospective citizens. Work permit routes it names include labour market impact assessment streams, the International Mobility Program, the Programme de l'expérience québécoise and the regular skilled worker program, along with permanent resident card renewals. The site notes that Nadia Barrou Avocate Inc. now operates as Barrou Immigration Inc. and says the team presents online webinars.
bartlaw-llp:
BARTLAW LLP is a Toronto firm handling Canadian immigration, citizenship and relocation matters for families and corporations.

The firm describes itself as a full-service citizenship and immigration practice working from a downtown Toronto office. According to its website, it assists with applications that allow temporary relocation or permanent immigration to Canada and represents clients in all aspects of cases before the federal immigration and citizenship ministry. It also describes enabling the cross-border transfer of professionals and business people. The site names Jacqueline Bart as a corporate immigration lawyer and presents a team page for its other lawyers.
batasar-law-brampton:
Batasar Law is a Brampton criminal defence practice led by Gary Batasar, who defends bail, domestic assault, sexual assault and impaired driving charges.

The site says Gary Batasar has practised for more than 28 years, mostly at the Brampton Courthouse and across the GTA, first as a student and then as a lawyer, and cites more than 20,000 cases. He studied at the University of Toronto and Queen's University and describes working with Judges, Crown Attorneys and police in Peel Region. Other charges named on the site include refusing a breathalyzer, dangerous driving and theft, and it also mentions his media commentary.
battista-migration-law-group:
Battista Migration Law Group is a Toronto immigration and refugee law firm with a particular focus on the LGBTQ+ community.

The firm says it has more than 30 years of experience in Canadian immigration law and helps clients who wish to visit, study or move permanently to Canada with their families. Its website describes appearances before the House of Commons and Senate on including same-sex and queer families in the definition of family, and before Parliamentary Standing Committees on removing medical inadmissibility. Articles on its site address LMIA requirements for employers, Express Entry CRS scores and Federal Court decisions on study permit refusals.
bcf-business-law:
BCF Business Law is a Montreal firm covering taxation, employment, real estate, litigation, financing and mergers and acquisitions. According to its website, it was founded in 1995 by eight lawyers and has offices in Montreal and Quebec City, plus a presence in Paris for intellectual property.

The firm serves businesses in Quebec, elsewhere in Canada and in Europe. Its site also presents BCF Global, an international division that assists companies and investors entering Quebec or expanding abroad, and BCF Ventures, a Canadian venture capital fund backed by the firm that invests in early-stage technology start-ups in areas such as artificial intelligence, cybersecurity and fintech.
bear-creek-law-llp:
Bear Creek Law LLP is a Surrey firm handling civil litigation, criminal defence, business disputes, debt collection and real estate disputes.

The firm explains that it avoids restricting its practice to one area, reasoning that judges hear many kinds of cases and that advisers focused on a single field may miss related issues. Its practice areas include white collar crime and civil forfeiture, privacy breaches, contempt of court, defamation, fraud and misrepresentation, collections, negligence and professional malpractice, and real estate and strata disputes. It says it wants to be its clients' lawyers for life and offers to check and revise agreements for business clients.
beard-winter-llp:
Beard Winter LLP is a Toronto firm acting in insurance litigation, corporate law, commercial litigation and employment law, and has done so since 1964.

Its insurance practice group acts for local, national and global insurers on accident benefits and Licence Appeal Tribunal matters, professional negligence and errors and omissions, and property and commercial general liability claims. The site says three members of that group have been appointed to the Ontario Superior Court of Justice. A separate team handles defence-side institutional human rights litigation before the Human Rights Tribunal of Ontario. The firm belongs to the Law Firm Alliance, a network of firms abroad.
bell-temple-llp:
Bell Temple LLP is a Toronto litigation firm handling commercial and general litigation, estates litigation, employment disputes and cybersecurity liability.

The firm says it provides litigation services to insurers and their policyholders and has been appointed counsel in high-profile and precedent-setting cases. Its list of matters is wide: environmental litigation involving oil spills and leaks, accident benefits and License Appeal Tribunal proceedings, professional negligence, medical malpractice, health discipline, regulatory proceedings and wrongful death. It also advises on privacy, data breach management and post-breach planning. The site names partners including David A. Tompkins, Brian E. Lucas and Hugh G. Brown, and describes its lawyers as trial counsel for multi-party disputes.
bellemare-avocats:
Bellemare Avocats is a Quebec City firm representing injured workers and accident victims in compensation matters before the CNESST, the SAAQ and IVAC. Its website says it contests decisions of these bodies before the Tribunal administratif du travail and the Tribunal administratif du Québec.

The practice is led by Marc Bellemare, and the firm cites 40 years of experience and also practises in class actions and civil liability in Quebec. It offers percentage-based or flat-fee billing and says it takes charge of the entire file for each client. The office is at 455 Rue du Marais.
bellissimo-immigration-law-group-pc-toro:
Bellissimo Immigration Law Group PC is a Toronto firm handling immigration, citizenship and refugee matters for individuals and families from around the world.

The firm says it is one of few remaining law firms in Canada that focus exclusively on citizenship, immigration and refugee law, and that its team's experience goes back more than forty-five years. It states that it has been responsible for key court decisions, policy work and publications in the field. Its work includes complex citizenship, immigration and refugee appeals and inadmissibility cases. The site also describes a client-centred approach with plain and transparent communication, and answers common questions about hiring an immigration lawyer in Canada.
benmor-family-law-group:
Benmor Family Law Group is a Toronto family law firm handling divorce, child and spousal support, custody and access, and mediation.

The firm describes a multi-disciplinary team led by Steve Benmor, a senior divorce lawyer, offering separation and divorce representation, mediation, divorce coaching and parenting coordination. Clients who do not need full representation can book a Divorce Strategy Session for advice at key stages. Its pages discuss parenting plans and schedules, the division of parental responsibilities, and Ontario's equalization of net family property, as well as cohabitation agreements and marriage contracts as ways to protect assets in advance.
bennett-jones-llp:
Bennett Jones LLP is a Toronto business law firm advising on corporate and M&A transactions, litigation, tax and regulatory matters.

The firm says businesses have turned to it for complex matters for about a century. Transactions on its site include KingSett Capital's C$9.4 billion acquisition of First Capital REIT, the acquisition of H&R REIT in a C$6.7 billion deal, Ovintiv's agreement to acquire NuVista Energy, and a C$1 billion Canada Infrastructure Bank financing for the Montréal-Trudeau transformation. It also acted for Canadian Pacific Kansas City in overturning a C$228 million judgment and publishes a quarterly private equity briefing.
bennett-jones-llp-calgary:
Bennett Jones LLP is a business law firm with a Calgary office in Bankers Hall East, handling energy, corporate and M&A, and dispute matters. The firm describes itself as having served businesses with complex legal matters for the last century, with services that include M&A, litigation, tax and regulatory work.

Its site lists transactions such as KKR's joint venture with Enbridge on the Westcoast pipeline system, the acquisition by Apollo funds of a 40% interest in Pembina Gas Infrastructure, Ovintiv's C$3.8 billion acquisition of NuVista Energy, and KingSett Capital's C$9.4 billion acquisition of First Capital REIT. It also reports acting for Canadian Pacific Kansas City in overturning a C$228 million judgment, and publishes an accessibility plan for its Toronto office.
berard-avocats-montreal:
Bérard Avocats is a Montreal firm handling civil, commercial, real estate and construction law disputes, established in the city in 2016.

The firm's site describes commercial disputes such as unpaid invoices and debts, missed deliveries by suppliers, difficulties with commercial leases and whether to incorporate, and says early legal advice can reduce the impact of such problems on a business. Its practice areas are listed as civil law, real estate law, construction law and commercial law, and it says it supports clients from diagnosis through to resolution of a file. The site also mentions a YouTube channel and refers to Me Bérard.
bergel-magence-guelph:
Bergel Magence is a personal injury firm listed in Guelph, with a Toronto practice for catastrophically injured clients across Ontario.

According to the firm, it was founded in 1972 by Hy Bergel, a former Provincial Court Deputy Judge, and is now led by partners Andrew Bergel, Ilan Bergel and Jeremy Magence. Its pages cover car, motorcycle, truck, pedestrian and bicycle accidents, slip and fall claims, dog bites, medical malpractice and brain injuries. The site lists services in English, French, Hebrew, Russian, Persian, Italian, Spanish and Chinese, and describes the practice as a three-generation family business.
bernard-brassard-avocats-d-affaires:
Bernard & Brassard, Avocats d'Affaires is a Longueuil firm of lawyers and notaries focused on business law.

Its site also lists labour, administrative, human rights and real estate law. The firm's website says it has worked on business law for more than 50 years and describes its approach as turning business law into business relationships. Besides its business law team, it names colleagues in administrative law, real estate law and human rights law. Its team page lists lawyers and notaries including Pascale April, Ruth Baillargeon, Xavier Bélanger, Alexis Belleville, Gabrielle Bourque, Calin Chiriac and Olivier Comeau-Vermeersch.
bernard-lau-and-co-law-office-richmond:
Based in Richmond, BC, this boutique firm led by Bernard Lau handles real estate conveyancing, civil litigation, builder's liens and wills and estates.

The firm, Bernard Lau and Co. Law Office, also lists defamation and notarization work and serves Richmond and Metro Vancouver. Its team is fluent in English, Mandarin and Cantonese, and the site notes a network of legal professionals overseas that supports out-of-town signings in China, Hong Kong and the wider Asia-Pacific region. It says it works with the major chartered banks on mortgages and helps with closing disputes such as home deficiencies, oil tank discoveries and collapsing deals.
bernier-fournier-avocats:
Bernier Fournier Avocats is a Drummondville firm advising small businesses on incorporation, contracts and reorganizations.

The firm's site says its multidisciplinary team looks at each situation from several angles and prepares a strategy to fit the client. Its SME pages describe help with company set-up, employment contracts and policies, distribution and supply contracts, security and collateral, share buybacks and issuances, and liquor permits. Corporate pages add sales, mergers and acquisitions, due diligence and the creation of subsidiaries or management companies. Recent news items mention Me Élody Southière and Me Gabriel Serena-Bélisle joining the team, and a new series of legal guides.
bernstein-law-group-personal-injury-lawy:
Bernstein Law Group is a Hamilton firm handling criminal defence, personal injury and mental health law matters from an office near the courthouse.

Founding lawyer Stephen Bernstein has more than 30 years of trial experience, and Robert Bernstein is also named on the site. The James Street office is close to the courthouse and the firm accepts Legal Aid. Its criminal pages cover domestic violence, drug and youth offences and bail hearings, while its injury pages cover motor vehicle accidents, wrongful death, slip and falls, spinal injuries and truck accidents. The firm says it represents clients throughout Hamilton and surrounding areas, including Burlington.
bhardwaj-co-family-law-edmonton:
Bhardwaj+Co is an Edmonton firm, with a second office in Leduc, handling family law, real estate, wills and estates, and employment matters.

Family services include divorce, uncontested divorce, custody, child support, separation agreements and spousal support, while employment work includes wrongful termination. The firm also describes residential purchases, wills, powers of attorney and probate. Puneet Bhardwaj graduated from Bond University in Australia in 2018 and articled in Edmonton; the team page also names Jesse Khehra, Claire M. Spicer and Lauren Hidalgo. The firm serves communities around Edmonton and Leduc.
bin-xia-zhang-montreal:
Bin Xia Zhang is a Montreal immigration lawyer who helps international students and temporary foreign workers seek permanent residence.

According to the site, the practice has run since 2016 and works mainly on temporary residence, permanent residence and Canadian citizenship applications. Bin Xia Zhang immigrated to Canada from China at age 9, and later worked in a college's international students department helping with temporary residence applications. The practice describes assessing eligibility, planning a route to permanent residence where a client is eligible, guiding clients toward eligibility where not, and helping prepare and assemble applications. The website is available in English and French and the office is on rue Saint-Jean.
bishop-mckenzie-llp: Bishop & McKenzie LLP is listed as a Calgary firm with litigation and corporate practice tags, at 605 5 Ave SW. No website was found for the firm, so nothing about its lawyers, history or approach is included in this entry. The listing is limited to the firm's name, address, city and practice areas in Alberta.
blake-cassels-graydon-llp:
Blake, Cassels & Graydon LLP, known as Blakes, is a Toronto business law firm advising on M&A and banking and finance matters.

The firm lists offices in Toronto, Calgary, Vancouver, Montréal, Ottawa, New York and London, and says it works for established business leaders and emerging entrepreneurs in Canada and abroad. Its site offers guides on foreign investment under the Investment Canada Act, merger planning in Canada, and doing business in Canada, along with a cybersecurity trends study and commentary on how artificial intelligence is changing business practice.
blake-cassels-graydon-llp-calgary:
Blake, Cassels & Graydon LLP, known as Blakes, is a business law firm with a Calgary office handling energy and litigation matters. Its site names offices in Toronto, Calgary, Vancouver, Montréal, Ottawa, New York and London.

The home page promotes a Canadian cybersecurity trends study, guides to the Investment Canada Act and to doing business in Canada, and a toolkit for planning mergers in Canada, alongside commentary on artificial intelligence. The firm states guiding principles that include building long-term client relationships, giving prompt and practical advice, and understanding each client's business drivers. The Calgary office is at 855 2 St SW.
blaney-mcmurtry-llp: Blaney McMurtry LLP is a Toronto, Ontario law firm with an office at 2 Queen St E. The firm's website text was not available in a usable form when this entry was prepared, and no practice tags are on file, so this listing is limited to its name and location. Details on its lawyers and areas of practice are found on the firm's own site.
blfon-personal-injury-lawyer-north-bay:
BLFON Personal Injury Lawyer is a North Bay firm handling car accidents, slip and falls and other injury cases in Ontario.

The site describes offices in Sarnia, North Bay and Collingwood and identifies the firm as a member of Barapp Law Alliance. Listed practice areas include car accidents, orthopaedic injuries, slip and fall accidents, motorcycle accidents, public transit accidents and pedestrian accidents. It says it acts on a contingency fee basis, so clients pay legal fees only if the case succeeds. The about page names lawyers including Eric Barapp, Lorne Weinstock, Eti Taylor, Nabeel Sera, Michael Brill and Albert Wong.
blottman-legal-services:
Blottman Legal Services is a Cookstown, Ontario firm handling traffic tickets, careless driving charges and driving-under-suspension matters across Ontario.

The firm describes a team of traffic ticket lawyers and paralegals, along with a criminal lawyer, and says it has handled thousands of traffic and driving-related charges in the province. Its site refers to Toronto and says clients speak directly with the people who attend court for them, with availability at all hours. Pages explain offences such as careless driving, and describe the office on Queen Street in Cookstown.
blp-avocats:
BLP Avocats is a Montreal business law firm handling litigation, banking and real estate, corporate and commercial matters, and technology. Its website also lists labour and insurance, urgent injunctions, entertainment and sports law.

The firm says its clients range from fast-growing start-ups to established companies and multinationals across business sectors. Its commercial litigation page covers oppression remedies, derivative actions, forced liquidation, fraud, breach of fiduciary duty and contract disputes. Lawyers named include Ugo Brisson, Louis Linteau, Stacey Bantos, Lee Rapkin and Aya Chehab, and its published articles address topics such as non-compete clauses and legal hypothecs on construction work. The office is on Rue Saint-Pierre.
blw-injury-law-waterloo:
BLW Injury Law is a Waterloo personal injury firm handling car accidents, slip and falls, motorcycle and pedestrian injuries, and public transit accidents.

The firm describes itself as a member of the Barapp Law Alliance. Its practice list also includes orthopaedic injuries and traumatic brain and spinal cord injuries, each with its own page on the site. According to the firm, clients are assigned a case manager and work on a contingency fee basis, meaning no fees are owed unless the case succeeds. The site also explains the time limits for filing a public transit accident lawsuit and the kinds of compensation that may be available.
boghossian-morais-llp-ottawa:
Boghossian Morais LLP is an Ottawa firm whose two lawyers and support staff work exclusively in immigration and refugee law.

The firm says it offers services in English, French, Armenian and Brazilian Portuguese. Its listed work includes Express Entry applications under the Canadian Experience Class and Federal Skilled Worker and Trades programs, provincial nominee applications, visitor and study permits, business immigration, intra-company transfers, work permits, hiring temporary foreign workers and family sponsorship. The team page identifies a founding member of the Canadian Immigration Lawyers Association, and appointments by Skype are available for clients outside the National Capital Region.
borden-ladner-gervais-llp-calgary:
Borden Ladner Gervais LLP, known as BLG, is a national Canadian firm with a Calgary office handling corporate, M&A and litigation matters. Its website says the firm has over 725 lawyers, intellectual property agents and other professionals, and that it acts as patent and trademark agents.

The site lists services from M&A and capital markets to disputes, financing, and trademark and patent registration. Recent items include a US$1.0 billion cross-border senior secured notes offering by OpenText, Telesat's infrastructure agreement for its Lightspeed satellite network, and insights on the Defence Production Act, workplace use of generative AI and Ontario's Construction Act. The Calgary office is in Centennial Place, East Tower.
bottos-law-group-edmonton:
Bottos Law Group is an Edmonton criminal defence firm representing people accused of serious criminal and regulatory charges across Alberta.

The firm says it was founded in 2012 and that its barristers have been involved in many high-profile criminal cases in Edmonton and elsewhere in the province. According to its site, it acts for individuals accused of any crime, and no matter is considered too small or too serious. Its lawyers, including Will van Engen, are described as offering straightforward and thorough legal advice. The firm also advertises articling positions for law students and publishes news items on its blog.
boudreau-law-winnipeg:
Boudreau Law is a Winnipeg firm handling Indigenous law, civil litigation, real estate, business, family and estates matters. Its website says the firm represents a large number of First Nation communities, tribal organizations and stakeholders, and that its team speaks English, French, Mandarin and Cantonese.

The firm describes litigation affirming treaty and aboriginal rights and challenging governmental decisions, in the Court of Queen's Bench, the Federal Court and the Supreme Court of Canada. Its services list also names administrative law, real estate transactions from residential sales to large commercial deals, business and corporate law, family law covering separation, divorce, paternity and custody, and estate planning. The office is at 201 Portage Avenue.
bouffard-law-office-greater-sudbury:
Bouffard Law Office in Greater Sudbury handles real estate, wills and estates, and corporate law for clients in Sudbury and French River.

The firm's website lists real estate purchases, sales, refinances, private mortgages and title transfers, along with wills of varying complexity, powers of attorney, probate and estate administration, and corporate organization. It describes a client-first approach aimed at simplifying complex legal processes and keeping communication clear from start to finish. The office is at 1351 Kelly Lake Road, Suite C5, and the site features a team page.
bourassa-gilbert-avocats: Bourassa Gilbert Avocats is a law office in Sherbrooke, Quebec, with its address listed at 315 Rue Marquette. No website or practice areas are on record for the firm, so this entry is limited to its name, location and address. The French name identifies it as a group of avocats, the term used in Quebec for lawyers. Details on the services it offers are not available.
bow-river-law-llp-calgary:
Bow River Law LLP is a Calgary boutique firm handling employment and labour law, including wrongful dismissal, severance and workplace discrimination.

Founders Joel Fairbrother and Sarah Coderre met at the University of Alberta in 2006 and started the firm near the beginning of 2021 after working as employment lawyers together. The site also names Chris Jones, Michael Hernandez and Amanda Jacinto. Services include constructive dismissal, lay-off, just cause, workplace investigations, employment policies, and disputes over fiduciary duty and non-competition. It notes that federally regulated workers in aviation, banking or telecommunications may be entitled to reinstatement, and offers a glossary of Alberta employment law terms.
brace-law-professional-corporation: Brace Law Professional Corporation is an Oakville firm whose website lists immigration, family law and civil litigation among its practice areas. The site describes the firm as serving Oakville, Vaughan, Hamilton and Toronto, with the Oakville office at 2939 Portland Drive, Unit 202. Beyond that short description, no page text from the firm's site was available for this entry, so nothing further about its lawyers or approach is stated here.
brar-tamber-rigby-badham:
Brar Tamber Rigby Badham is a Mississauga and Toronto firm known for personal injury and commercial litigation.

According to its site, the firm was founded on August 22, 2017 and offers eight practice areas, including real estate, criminal defence, immigration, estates, employment and corporate law. Its injury work covers motor vehicle accidents, slip and falls, disability matters, brain injury and wrongful death, while its commercial litigators handle contract breaches, shareholder disputes, commercial fraud and injunctions. Structured site data lists English, Punjabi and Hindi, and service areas across the GTA including Markham, Milton, Ajax and Caledon.
brass-law-office-ottawa:
Brass Law Office is an Ottawa criminal defence firm acting for people accused of criminal and quasi-criminal offences.

According to its site, its lawyers have practised for over 25 years. The firm lists murder, assault, mischief, robbery, fraud, sexual offences and driving charges among the allegations it defends. It says it retains outside professionals such as private investigators, DNA analysts, pathologists, toxicologists, blood spatter analysts and forensic accountants to support a case. It also describes seeking remedies for Charter breaches, including unlawful detentions and arrests, unreasonable searches and seizures, and violations of the right to counsel. The firm is on Somerset Street West.
brentwood-law-corporation:
Brentwood Law Corporation is a Burnaby firm handling real estate, corporate and business law, and wills and estates.

The firm was founded by Olja Simic, who advises individuals, families, small business owners and corporations. Her corporate work covers forming business entities, buying and selling businesses, corporate structuring, commercial leasing, governance and contract negotiation. Real estate work includes residential, recreational and commercial purchases, sales, leasing and refinancing, and estate planning includes planning for mental incapacity and business succession. The site also describes a family law team handling custody, adoption, surrogacy and divorce, and the office is on Willingdon Avenue.
brett-mcgarry-criminal-law-ottawa:
Brett McGarry Criminal Law is an Ottawa defence firm handling impaired driving, sexual assault, drug and bail matters in Eastern Ontario.

According to the site, Brett McGarry has been licensed by the Law Society of Ontario since 2008 and has more than 18 years of criminal defence practice in Ottawa and across the province. He is described as acting for many clients who are professionals with no earlier involvement in the criminal justice system. The firm publishes case summaries involving Charter rulings and trials in the Superior Court, and a separate page on Ottawa impaired driving charges covers over 80, refusing a breath sample and care-and-control offences.
briand-s-a-avocats:
Briand Avocats is a Quebec City firm handling immigration, business immigration, mergers and acquisitions and commercial law. Its website describes legal strategy for business immigration, company acquisitions and commercial transactions in Quebec, with offices in Montreal and Quebec City.

The firm lists Quebec and Canada as its service area, and its Quebec City office is in the Tour Belle Cour on Boulevard Laurier. Its site text was limited when this entry was prepared, so the description here is confined to the practice areas and offices it states.
brisebois-law-office-windsor:
Brisebois Law Office is a Windsor firm handling civil litigation, corporate and commercial law, real estate and mortgages, and estate planning.

Founded in 1996, the firm describes itself as a local practice that gets to know clients, their businesses and their goals, and says its lawyers have over 30 years of combined experience. Its practice areas include advocacy and civil litigation, business services and corporate and commercial matters. The site also lists service languages and accepted coverage, and describes a team approach in which members share experience.
broderick-partners-llp: Broderick & Partners LLP is a law firm in Niagara Falls, Ontario, with an office on Ontario Avenue. No practice areas, lawyers or services are described for the firm in the information available for this directory, so the entry lists only its name, its Niagara Falls location and its street address. Further details have not been published here.
browne-criminal-defence-calgary:
Browne Criminal Defence is a Calgary practice where lawyer Matt Browne works only on criminal law in Alberta and British Columbia.

Before law school he earned a Bachelor of Science in Chemical Engineering at the University of Alberta and worked for oil and gas companies in North America and Southeast Asia, from heavy oil in Fort McMurray to natural gas in the Gulf of Thailand. The firm's site says he draws on that science background when forensic evidence is at issue in court. He has appeared at all levels of court in both provinces. Its pages walk through disclosure analysis, the criminal process and strategy meetings.
brownlee-llp:
Brownlee LLP is a regional firm with an Edmonton office, acting for municipalities, individuals and companies in litigation, municipal and corporate matters. Its website says the firm has offices in Calgary, Edmonton, Vancouver and Regina and serves clients across Alberta, Saskatchewan, British Columbia, Yukon, Nunavut and the Northwest Territories.

It names civil litigation, municipal and administrative law, corporate-commercial law, and employment and labour as its core groups. The firm says it was founded by John E. Brownlee, who served as Alberta's fifth head of government, and it publishes case analysis, a practical guide to shareholder disputes and on-demand insurance law webinars for insurance professionals.
brum-immigration-ottawa:
Brum Immigration is an Ottawa practice led by Renata Brum, a former Senior Citizenship Judge of Canada and Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant.

The site says Brum served for 11 years as a citizenship judge, was born in the Azores, Portugal, and limits the practice to a select number of clients so that every case is managed personally. Applications it names include provincial nominee programs, Canadian citizenship, citizenship waivers on compassionate grounds and the Citizenship Act subsection 5(4) route. The firm also lists services for business clients moving workers to Canada and has begun offering US immigration services.
brunet-jean-avocat: Brunet Jean Avocat is a family law lawyer in Trois-Rivieres, Quebec, listed at 190 Rue Bonaventure. The directory records family law as the practice area, but no website or description is available for the lawyer, so no specific services, languages or court appearances are stated. Family law in Quebec is the field that covers matters such as separation, divorce and child custody.
bryan-and-company-llp:
Bryan & Company LLP is a full-service Edmonton firm advising on corporate, real estate, restructuring and securities matters. Headquartered in Manulife Place, the firm says it acts for individuals, public and private companies and not-for-profit entities across Canada and internationally, and has worked with clients across generations.

Its areas of practice include bankruptcy, insolvency, receiverships and restructuring, and securities, corporate finance and capital markets. The firm says it aims to combine the strength of a large firm with the comfort of a small one, and to give practical, cost-effective advice tailored to each organization, from day-to-day legal matters to transactions and disputes.
bulwark-law-criminal-defence-lawyer-calg:
Bulwark Law Criminal Defence is a Calgary firm handling assault, bail, driving offences, financial crime and murder and manslaughter charges across Alberta.

Owner Jeremy Newton obtained his law degree in 2011, worked first as a generalist, and then spent more than ten years as a Federal Prosecutor on cases across Alberta, where he also trained police and correctional officers. The firm's site says he took a case to the Supreme Court of Canada, and recalls that his father was a criminal defence lawyer. Bulwark Law has offices in Calgary and Airdrie, and its pages describe each area of practice in turn.
burnet-duckworth-palmer-llp:
Burnet, Duckworth & Palmer LLP is an independent Calgary firm advising on energy, litigation, finance and corporate matters. Its website says the firm acts for clients ranging from startups to large national companies and describes its approach as tailored legal solutions.

The practice list covers banking and finance, business law, capital markets, commercial real estate, competition and foreign investment, employment and labour, energy, environmental, social and governance work, and infrastructure and project development. The site mentions that the firm represented Inter Pipeline Ltd. in a precedent-setting decision and that Gary Sharma joined as an associate in its tax group. The Calgary office is on 8 Ave SW.
bussey-ainsworth-lawyers-peterborough:
Bussey Ainsworth Lawyers is a Peterborough firm serving the Kawarthas since 1988 in real estate, wills, estates, business and charity law.

The firm describes itself as small and local, and says it has closed property purchases and sales across the Kawarthas for four decades, including homes, cottages and farms. Barry Bussey has appeared before the Supreme Court of Canada, holds a doctorate in law from Leiden University and has written on constitutional rights and religious liberty. The firm also advises charities on incorporation, governance and the Ontario Not-for-Profit Corporations Act transition, and its lawyers act as notaries public and commissioners of oaths.
cain-lamarre-chicoutimi:
Cain Lamarre's Chicoutimi office, in Saguenay, was founded in 1928 and hosts the firm's regional management for Saguenay–Lac-Saint-Jean.

The firm's site says the office is where Me Michael Cain and Me François Lamarre practised, and that it now has 34 professionals. Teams there cover business law, banking and insolvency, municipal, environmental, labour, construction, family and notarial law, and Indigenous law. The office also houses the head of the environmental law group and the head of the construction law group for all of Quebec, and Me Jean-Pierre Lévesque is named as managing partner for the region.
cain-lamarre-rouyn-noranda:
Cain Lamarre has an office on Rue Gamble Ouest in Rouyn-Noranda, part of a Quebec firm covering all fields of law.

The firm's site describes legal solutions for institutions, businesses and individuals, offered with a human and rigorous approach, and lists 15 offices across the province and 15 areas of practice. The page for this location gives little local detail, so no named lawyers or local practice areas are stated here. The site also invites applicants to join the team.
campbell-froh-may-rice-llp:
Campbell Froh May & Rice LLP is a Richmond law firm listed under business law and real estate, with an office at 5611 Cooney Road, Suite 200.

The firm's own website did not load when this entry was prepared, so its lawyers, services and approach are not described here. The directory records only its name, its Richmond, British Columbia address and its business law and real estate practice tags.
campbell-litigation-waterloo:
Campbell Litigation is a Waterloo practice handling personal injury, wrongful death and commercial and construction disputes in Kitchener-Waterloo.

Lawyer Richard Campbell has litigated since 1999, working mainly for plaintiffs in personal injury, professional negligence, product liability, secured creditors' remedies and contract matters. He holds a Bachelor of Arts from St. Jerome's College and a Juris Doctor from Osgoode Hall Law School, and conducts trials and appeals in the Ontario courts. The site says he advises early on whether a dispute can be mediated, arbitrated or negotiated before litigation. Its articles cover fiduciary duty in closely held companies and ATV accidents.
campisi-law-st-catharines-st-catharines:
Campisi Law is an Ontario personal injury firm handling accident injury, disability and accident benefits cases for clients across the province.

This office is listed in St. Catharines at 110 James Street, Suite 400, while the firm's site describes particular depth in the Greater Toronto Area and mentions Vaughan. It says support is available in more than 20 languages. Injury work is handled under a contingency fee agreement, meaning fees depend on a successful settlement or trial outcome, and the site refers to reports from physicians, accident reconstruction engineers and economists. Soft tissue injuries and rehabilitation planning are among the topics covered.
cangaly-montreal:
Cangaly is a Montreal immigration consulting company assisting with Quebec PEQ, federal Express Entry, provincial nomination and study permit applications.

Its website, written in Chinese, says the company is registered to handle entry and exit affairs, immigration and study abroad, employment placement, and education training. The consultant it presents holds a bachelor's degree in applied linguistics and a master's in information processing and analysis, previously worked at the China Scholarship Council, and can represent clients before immigration authorities, the border agency and the Immigration and Refugee Board on appeal. The firm also says it carries one million dollars of insurance each year and has teams in Canada and China.
capelle-kane-immigration-lawyers-ottawa:
Capelle Kane Immigration Lawyers is an Ottawa firm advising on Canadian citizenship and immigration, with corporate immigration work for employers.

The firm says it has given legal advice on these laws since 1994 and that two of its lawyers hold Law Society of Ontario certification in citizenship and immigration law, which it describes as unique among Ottawa firms. Its work covers bringing international talent to Canada for Canadian and multinational companies, reuniting families, and reducing delays in visa processing. Betsy Kane, a founding partner, began her career with Citizenship and Immigration Canada at national headquarters in Ottawa.
carbert-waite-llp-calgary:
Carbert Waite LLP is a Calgary litigation firm covering commercial, employment, construction, condominium, insurance and personal injury disputes.

The firm says it was founded in 1999 and acts for local, American and international clients in high-stakes matters across Alberta's key industries. Its service pages also list alternative dispute resolution, health law, immigration, estate planning and business law. The employment and labour group is described as one of the largest in Calgary, advising both employers and employees across Alberta and western Canada. Lawyers named on the site include Roxanne Davis, KC, and Michael Waite, KC. Its approach is described as practical, client-centred and tailored to each case.
caron-schetagne-avocates:
Caron Schetagne, Avocates is a Saint-Jerome firm practising family law, family mediation and real estate disputes.

Its directory title also refers to litiges immobilier and the TAL, the Tribunal administratif du logement, which hears housing disputes in Quebec. The firm is listed in the Réseau des professionnels du droit du Québec for the Laurentides region, at 489 Rue Laviolette. The page itself offers sections on services, hours and accepted payments but no further description of the cases handled.
cashion-legal-employment-lawyers-calgary:
Cashion Legal is a Calgary employment law firm handling wrongful dismissal, constructive dismissal, severance packages and workplace discrimination in Alberta.

The firm acts for employees, small businesses and entrepreneurs, and says representing both sides gives it a view of each party's motivations. Its team has experience in trials, appeals, mediations and arbitrations.
