himpro-personal-injury-and-long-term-dis:
HIMPRO is a Toronto firm handling personal injury, car accident, medical malpractice and long-term disability matters across the GTA.

The site presents HIMPRO as the personal injury division of Himelfarb Proszanski, whose wider practice includes business, corporate commercial, real estate and litigation work. HIMPRO lawyers focus on personal injury, disability and insurance law and act for clients in Toronto, Brampton, Hamilton, Kitchener, Oshawa and surrounding areas. The firm says it has been helping individuals, families and businesses for over 30 years and that fees depend on the outcome of the case.
hnt-law-guelph:
HNT Law is a Guelph firm handling residential real estate purchases, sales and refinancing, along with wills and estate planning for Ontario clients.

According to its website, the firm analyzes paperwork, performs title searches and prepares the legal documents needed when a client buys or sells a home. Founder Hai Tran also teaches as an Assistant Professor of Law at the University of Guelph, with courses that range from Real Estate Law to Canadian Business Law. On the estates side, the firm says it has guided hundreds of clients through wills, powers of attorney and related planning. Its site is titled as serving both Guelph and Toronto.
hoare-claxton-criminal-defence:
Hoare Claxton Criminal Defence is a Calgary firm defending drug, assault, impaired driving and other charges in Alberta courts.

Its lawyers appear in Calgary and across Alberta, and the site groups its work into drug offences, offences against the person, property offences and offences against the administration of justice.

The firm, founded in 1996 according to its structured data, has four trial lawyers: Peter A. Hoare, Mike C. Gilchrist, Alexander Koustov and Sadaf Raja. It says they have more than 110 years of combined courtroom experience, and that Mr. Hoare has practised only criminal defence for 30 years. Its site lists 21 practice areas, including bail hearings, domestic violence, sexual offences, criminal driving offences and Immediate Roadside Sanctions, and says it answers around the clock from its office on 6 Ave SW.
holmes-stephen-a-brampton:
Stephen Holmes Law Office is a Brampton practice offering real estate, wills and estates, and business law in Peel, Halton and the GTA.

Listed in directories as Holmes Stephen A, its website states that the lawyer has 20 years of experience with residential purchases, sales and refinances, and 30 years in commercial real estate. Real estate is the first area on the site, followed by wills and estates and business law.
holness-and-small-law-group:
Holness and Small Law Group is a Vancouver firm handling personal injury and family law matters for clients across British Columbia.

The firm says it has been locally owned and operated since 1999 and that its office faces the Vancouver Courthouse, which it describes as convenient for court appearances anywhere in the province. It states that it has represented thousands of clients over more than twenty years and describes its injury work as civil litigation for people who have suffered injury, loss or damage, including claims against ICBC and other insurers. Its site also carries articles on medical malpractice, informed consent and standard of care, and a family law section dealing with dividing property, assets and debt.
hometown-law:
Hometown Law is a Hamilton firm offering real estate closings, wills and powers of attorney, and probate services.

The firm says it has been in business for ten years and presents itself as a single stop for needs ranging from buying a home to estate matters. Its wills page explains why a will matters, including what happens when there are dependent children, and describes powers of attorney for personal care as well as continuing and non-continuing powers of attorney for property. A separate service page covers guiding families through the probate of an estate.
hoogbruin-and-company-vancouver:
Hoogbruin & Company is a Vancouver litigation firm handling strata, real estate and commercial disputes, along with injury and wrongful death claims.

The firm's website says it has taken on cases across British Columbia since 1987. Its practice pages cover strata corporations, strata owners and tenants, real estate litigation, commercial litigation, wills and estates, slip, trip and fall injuries, medical malpractice and wrongful death. Lawyers named on the site are Michael Hoogbruin, Arsen Krekovic and Abraham An. Its about page describes how injuries can affect work, family and mental health, and sets out the fee structure the firm uses. The office is on Alberni Street in downtown Vancouver.
houlihan-law-sarnia:
Houlihan Law is a downtown Sarnia practice focused on real estate, mortgages, wills, powers of attorney and estate administration.

Spencer Houlihan was born and raised in Sarnia. He earned a law degree from Griffith University in 2014 after an honours degree in political science at Laurier, and was called to the Ontario bar in June 2017. His site also lists notary public services and says the office uses technology to save clients time. Outside the office he has been a long-standing member of the Sarnia Saints Rugby and Football Club, serving on its board and as president in 2021.
howie-sacks-and-henry-llp:
Howie, Sacks & Henry LLP is a Toronto personal injury firm that also lists car accident claims among its practice areas.

The only site content available is a Linktree page, where the firm, known as HSH, says it helps clients rebuild their lives. The page links to a profile of lawyer Michael J. Henry, a long-term disability guide, team and firm background pages, and blog articles. It also links to news coverage of Stolen Time, a Hot Docs documentary about elder rights advocate Melissa Miller, and of a lawsuit against the Ontario government. The firm's office is on Queen Street West.
hsp-law-north-york:
HSP Law is a North York personal injury firm handling car accidents, slip and falls, dog bites and long-term disability matters.

The firm says it has acted for injured people for over 40 years and lists offices in Whitby, Oshawa, Toronto, Niagara Falls and Calgary. Its pages also cover ATV and snowmobile accidents and cases involving the death of a loved one through negligence. Harlan A. Pottins is named on the about page. HSP Law states that clients pay no upfront legal fees or costs, with payment due only on a successful outcome.
hughes-law-corporation-vancouver:
Hughes Law Corporation is a Vancouver firm handling residential and commercial real estate conveyancing, mortgage refinancing and landlord and tenant disputes.

The firm says it has been in business for close to 30 years. Its other areas include wills and estates and business acquisitions and sales. Principal lawyer Cedric Hughes is a University of British Columbia graduate and a member of the Law Society of British Columbia. The site notes that many clients live outside Vancouver, and that meeting offices around the Lower Mainland, including North Vancouver and Surrey/Delta, allow the lawyers to come to the client.
hum-employment-law-firm-toronto:
Hum Employment Law Firm is a Toronto firm focused on workplace and employment law, human rights, investigations and mediation.

The firm says it practises in Ontario and Quebec, in English and French, for employers and employees and for plaintiffs and defendants. Its main office is in downtown Toronto, with additional offices in Markham, Mississauga, Richmond Hill and Scarborough and appointments also held in London, Ontario and Montreal. Services listed include workplace investigations, shareholder disputes, professional regulation matters and litigation, and employer guidance on contracts, policies, risk management and compliance. The site publishes articles on topics such as constructive dismissal, medical leave and AI use in the workplace.
ig-law-professional-corporation-london:
IG Law Professional Corporation is a London, Ontario firm that handles real estate transactions, wills and estates, powers of attorney and notary public work.

The firm says it acts on residential property, commercial property, farm property, vacant land, condo and cottage purchases and sales, and also lists commercial loan transactions of all types. Its site mentions reviewing purchase and sale agreements and keeping clients informed through a transaction, and land transfers are named among its filings. IG Law says it offers option-based strategies and friendly service that can be delivered from a client's home or office.
immiland-montreal:
Immiland is a Montreal immigration consulting company that helps families, workers and students plan a move to Canada, with its website written in Spanish.

Its service list covers immigration, recruitment, education, translation and settlement, along with pages on working in Canada, studying in Canada and tourist visas. The firm says it holds more than 100 education agreements with colleges, universities and institutes recognized as Designated Learning Institutions, which lets it process study permits. Its site also addresses practical settlement questions such as choosing a neighbourhood. Immiland states that it is regulated by the Law Society of Ontario and the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants, and its office is on Rue Parthenais.
incorporation-gatineau:
Incorporation Gatineau is a Gatineau business law service covering incorporation, registration and legal structure for new companies. Its site is presented under the Décarie Avocats name, and the team is described as business lawyers in Gatineau and Sorel-Tracy.

The site lists benefits of incorporating: a patrimony separate from that of the shareholders, limited personal liability, a lower tax rate than for an individual, and the ability to keep earnings in the company for later use. It says the lawyers advise on whether and when to incorporate, file the incorporation and registration with the government, and help avoid common structuring errors. The address is 3 Rue de Picardie, Suite 200.
infinity-law-victoria:
Infinity Law is a Victoria, BC firm offering real estate, corporate, family, estate and immigration services on Vancouver Island.

The site says the firm was founded in 2013 through the union of two Victoria law firms. It lists two Victoria offices, Broadmead and Downtown, plus Mill Bay, Nanaimo and Vancouver. Its structured data names a service area covering Sidney, Sooke, Esquimalt, Oak Bay, Saanich, Langford, Colwood and Metchosin, and the site describes work across Vancouver Island. Practice pages also cover estate planning and administration, commercial litigation and immigration services in Victoria and Nanaimo.
insight-law-professional-corporation:
Insight Law Professional Corporation is a Toronto firm handling real estate, business and corporate law, wills and estates, and notary services.

The firm says its lawyers have over 23 years of combined experience and have represented more than 1,100 clients across Ontario. Its real estate work covers residential, commercial, recreational and rural purchases, sales, refinancing, leasing and condo status matters. Offices are listed in Toronto, near Yonge and Eglinton, and in Ottawa. Lawyers are described as working in English, French, Turkish and basic Italian. The notary side of the practice handles affidavits, certified true copies, travel consent letters and witnessed signatures.
iqbal-law-professional-corporation-missi:
Iqbal Law is a Mississauga family law practice led by Nasar Iqbal, handling divorce, custody, support and property division across the GTA.

Nasar Iqbal works as a sole practitioner after earlier work with downtown firms and the Ministry of the Attorney General, according to the site. He speaks English, Urdu, Punjabi and Hindi and appears at all levels of Ontario courts. The firm lists clients in Oakville, Hamilton, Newmarket, Oshawa, Barrie, Kitchener, Woodstock, Sarnia and London, and also offers unbundled services for self-represented people. Its pages cover high-value asset division, parenting disputes and a family law blog.
isenberg-and-shuman-north-york:
Isenberg & Shuman is a boutique firm in North York, Toronto, handling real estate, wills and powers of attorney, estate administration and business law.

The firm says it helps hundreds of clients each year and offers remote video conference signings whenever needed. Its wills page explains why a valid will and power of attorney matter, noting that a power of attorney lets a person appoint someone to manage personal and financial affairs in the event of incapacity. The practice areas listed are real estate law, wills and powers of attorney, estate administration and business law, and the site publishes articles on these topics.
j-kalirai-law-firm-mississauga:
Kalirai Law Firm is a Mississauga criminal defence firm covering drug, driving, assault and other offences, founded by lawyer Jeevan Kalirai.

The site lists arson, assault and related charges, drug offences under the Controlled Drugs and Substances Act and the Cannabis Act, impaired and dangerous driving, driving while disqualified, criminal harassment and criminal negligence causing death. Jeevan Kalirai holds an LL.B. (Honours) and a B.A. in Biomedical Sciences (Honours). The firm says it works at every level of court and offers flat fee pricing and flexible payment plans. The office is on Burnhamthorpe Road West.
jahanshahi-business-law-firm-north-york:
Jahanshahi Business Law Firm is a North York firm advising on business purchases and sales, shareholder disputes and ongoing corporate matters.

The firm says it supports startups, entrepreneurs, franchise operations and small or mid-sized businesses, and its work also touches real estate, estate planning and tax planning. It gives ongoing counsel on contracts, corporate matters and reorganizations, and acts for buyers and sellers from structuring and due diligence through closing. For shareholder disputes it addresses ownership, management, control and the breakdown of business relationships. The site also offers general guidance on choosing a law firm, covering experience, fees and disbursements.
jalbert-lamarre-avocats:
Jalbert Lamarre Avocats is a Quebec City firm handling civil litigation, business, criminal, housing, employment and administrative law. Its website highlights a single hourly rate of 295 dollars for every client, businesses and individuals alike, regardless of income.

The firm, which uses the short name JLA, also assists with starting up, registering and incorporating a business, and offers legal translation between English and French at 20 cents per word. It says it serves clients throughout the province of Quebec, and its office is on Boulevard Bastien.
james-deep-law-professional-corporation:
James Deep Law Professional Corporation is an Oakville firm handling real estate closings, wills and estates, and notary services across Halton. Its website says the practice has operated for over thirty years and that James Deep, who studied law at Western University, has served the Oakville community since 1994.

Real estate work includes agreement checks, title searches and closings for purchases, sales and refinancing, while estate services cover wills, powers of attorney and estate administration with fixed-fee pricing. Notarial services include affidavits, statutory declarations, certified copies and travel consent letters, with same-day service described. The site names the Halton and Greater Toronto Area as its service area and lists a support team that includes real estate law clerks.
james-h-brown-and-associates-edmonton:
James H Brown & Associates is an Edmonton personal injury firm acting for Albertans hurt in car accidents and other serious accidents.

The site says the firm was formed by James H. Brown, who at 19 suffered a broken neck in a head-on collision with a drunk driver, ending his professional hockey career. Injury types it describes include spinal cord injury, traumatic brain injury, whiplash and wrongful death, and it cites over 200 years of combined experience among its lawyers. The firm says its aim is to help injured people recover compensation for medical expenses, lost wages and other damages, and it describes itself as handling precedent-setting car accident cases.
jarod-alie-avocat: Jarod Alie Avocat is a Repentigny lawyer whose listed practice areas are traffic tickets and criminal defence. The office is at 1 Croissant des Dirigeants. No website or further description is on record for the lawyer, so specific offences, courts and languages are not stated here. The entry is limited to the name, location and the two practice areas given in the directory.
jarrah-law-edmonton:
Jarrah Law is an Edmonton firm handling family law and criminal defence for Albertans.

The family law side covers parenting and access disputes, child and spousal support, and division of family property. Criminal defence covers assaults, firearm and weapon offences, theft and break and enter, impaired driving, drug charges, and advice on police interviews. The lawyer writes in the first person, offers up to one hour of initial legal advice, and describes a paperless process with digital signatures and different options for hiring. The site stresses familiarity with court procedures, timelines and tactics.
jasmin-sandhu-immigration-lawyer-toronto:
Jasmin Sandhu Law is a Toronto immigration and refugee firm handling permanent residence, refugee claims, appeals, visas and citizenship.

Its website lists Express Entry, family sponsorship, humanitarian and compassionate applications, Ontario nominee programs, and work and study permits. Jasmin Sandhu is a member of the Law Society and an Ontario Notary Public, and the site says she belongs to JusticeNet and the Legal Aid panel. Ireesha Jethanandani, a licensed paralegal, is the first person clients meet. Areas served include Ajax, Woodbridge, Vaughan, Mississauga, Brampton, Whitby, Oshawa and Barrie, and the firm lists several language options.
jason-bryk-kc-winnipeg:
Jason Bryk KC is a Winnipeg real estate lawyer at Pitblado Law, handling development, condominiums, subdivisions, acquisitions, sales and financing. His site biography says he regularly assists developers, homebuilders, apartment investors, brokerages, borrowers and lenders from across Canada with Manitoba matters.

Before practising in Manitoba he worked for a multinational real estate development company based in Winnipeg, served as District Registrar for the Manitoba Property Registry and was a member of Grandall Legal Group in Beijing. He studied at Peking University, the University of Kent at Canterbury and the University of Winnipeg. Pitblado traces its history to 1882 and took its present form in a 1998 merger, and the office is at 360 Main Street.
jason-wuttunee-criminal-defence-lawyer-c:
Jason Wuttunee is a Calgary criminal defence lawyer who represents people accused of homicide, drug offences, impaired driving and financial crimes.

Before opening his defence practice he spent eleven years as a Crown Prosecutor with Alberta Justice, handling hundreds of criminal matters including high-profile cases, and acted as appellate counsel before the Alberta Court of Appeal. His site says he practises trial and appellate litigation in all areas of criminal law and in select civil matters. Separate pages cover first and second degree murder and infanticide, and white-collar offences such as embezzlement, tax evasion, securities fraud, money laundering and mortgage fraud.
jeffrey-i-reisman-north-york:
Jeffrey Reisman is a criminal defence lawyer in North York serving Toronto and the GTA on bail hearings, impaired driving, assault and drug charges.

The site says he has practised criminal law since 2001, first as a prosecutor for three years and then on the defence side. He has appeared in the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Ontario, in courts in Quebec, and in United States federal court in the Middle District of Florida. Listed practice areas include sexual and domestic assault, probation violations, fraud and theft, property offences and murder. The firm also states that it is available around the clock.
jeffrey-r-horricks-law-corporation-vanco:
Jeffrey Horricks Law Corporation is a Vancouver practice handling real estate, corporate and estate law.

Jeffrey Horricks was born and raised in Vancouver, studied at the University of Victoria and earned his Juris Doctor from Bond University in Australia. After returning in 2012 he worked at a corporate and securities firm and then at a boutique criminal law practice, and he established Horricks Law in 2014. The firm serves individuals, families and businesses across Vancouver and the Lower Mainland, with real estate pages covering strata properties, mortgages and financing, and development and investment deals. It says clients speak directly with the lawyer and that flat-fee options are offered.
jeremie-john-martin-montreal:
Jérémie John Martin is a bilingual Montreal litigation lawyer who practises and pleads in both French and English.

According to his website, Me Martin is originally from Quebec, now lives on the Island of Montreal and serves all judicial districts of Quebec. He favours a diplomatic approach aimed at settling files out of court, while remaining ready to plead. In 2006 he took the national inter-university debating championship Face à Face in Sherbrooke with colleague Yves Tanguay, and also earned the individual pleader's bursary. The site has pages on his services, fees, the courthouses he serves, partners and associates, and media appearances.
jeremy-m-feuer-real-estate-wills-winnipe:
Jeremy Feuer Law Corporation is a Winnipeg firm handling real estate, wills and probate, with offices in Winnipeg and Selkirk.

The corporation was founded in 2013 by principal Jeremy M. Feuer to concentrate on real estate law and wills and estate work. Its website describes a locally owned boutique that emphasizes efficiency, transparency and professionalism, and says it does not advertise, so most clients arrive on the recommendation of other industry professionals. On probate, the firm explains that the Court of King's Bench in Manitoba oversees the process, and it says it helps prepare the application and guides executors through estate administration for clients in Winnipeg, Selkirk, the Interlake and across Manitoba.
jessie-s-brar-criminal-defence-winnipeg:
Jessie Brar Criminal Defence is a Winnipeg practice defending impaired driving, drug, weapons, violent and sexual offence charges. Its website identifies Jessie Brar as a partner at Steigerwald Hodge Pinx & Brar LLP who works in criminal defence, with a strategic approach and courtroom advocacy.

He has defended charges including impaired driving, property offences, violent and sexual offences, weapons and drug offences, and homicide. The site says he holds a Juris Doctor from the University of North Dakota School of Law, began his career at Gindin Wolson Simmonds Roitenberg and joined Simmonds and Associates in 2021, working with Saul B. Simmonds, K.C. His office is at 444 St Mary Avenue.
jim-dean-law-professional-corporation-lo:
Jim Dean Law Professional Corporation is a London, Ontario firm focused on criminal law and wills and estate planning.

According to its website, Jim Dean founded the firm in 2011 after about two decades as a police officer, and it has since grown to four full-time employees. The site lists lawyers Chris Marquis and Victoria Heppenheimer and senior law clerk Tammy Courage alongside Dean, who is a barrister, solicitor and notary public. The firm is based at the Hamilton Road Legal Centre, notes after-hours availability for clients in custody, and also describes assistance to other lawyers and professionals.
jk-law-calgary:
JK Law is a Calgary firm offering real estate, corporate and commercial, wills and estates, immigration, personal injury and child welfare legal services.

The firm says its lawyers have more than three decades of combined experience serving clients in Canada and abroad, and that it acts for people in Calgary and surrounding areas. Its site lists Jide Kupoluyi and Ola Ogbonna among the team. On real estate it describes residential and commercial purchases and sales, while its business practice is aimed at owners and entrepreneurs, whom the lawyers say they understand because they run businesses themselves. Immigration work covers temporary visas, permanent residence and citizenship, and the office also offers notary public and commissioner for oaths services.
jodoin-associes-avocats:
Jodoin & Associés Avocats is a Granby firm handling civil and commercial litigation, family law and business law.

Its site also lists corporate, insurance and hidden-defect disputes, estates, tax and employment law. The firm says it serves Granby and surrounding communities including Bromont, Lac Brome and Waterloo, and meets clients at its office or, on request, at their home. Its Waterloo pages describe help for business owners with contract drafting, commercial disputes and incorporation steps, and civil matters such as neighbour conflicts, damage suits and contract problems. The firm presents its work as covering both prevention and defence of clients' interests before the courts.
john-mcgarrity-professional-corporation:
John McGarrity Professional Corporation is a Peterborough firm handling family law, real estate, wills and estates, and business law matters. According to its website, it also offers arbitration and mediation, and encourages clients to use these private routes where a dispute does not need to go to court.

The firm says it has over twenty-five years of family law experience, covering divorce, cohabitation agreements, child support and custody. Its real estate work covers buying, selling, refinancing and mortgages, and its estates practice prepares wills and powers of attorney and assists executors. The site describes a calm, respectful and transparent approach and places the office at 343 Stewart Street.
joseph-a-nagy-injury-law-edmonton:
This Edmonton injury firm handles motor vehicle accident and personal injury cases for people in central and northern Alberta. Its site covers car, truck, motorcycle and bicycle collisions.

Joseph A. Nagy Injury Law says each of its injury lawyers has more than 20 years of experience and that a senior lawyer keeps a file from the first meeting through resolution rather than passing it to a junior. The team page names Joseph A. Nagy and Howard Poon. Fees are contingency based, and the site states that clients owe no legal fees until a case is resolved. It also publishes a page on Alberta's switch to no-fault auto insurance, branded Care-First and set for January 1, 2027, and notes that the firm has opposed no-fault coverage and supports FAIR Alberta.
joshua-rogala-criminal-law-winnipeg: Joshua Rogala Criminal Law is listed as a Winnipeg criminal defence practice at 155 Carlton Street, Suite 1640. Its website did not load when this entry was compiled, so details of its lawyer, history and approach are not included. The listing is limited to the firm's name, address, city and practice area in Manitoba.
joshua-slayen-immigration-lawyer:
Joshua Slayen Immigration Lawyer is a Vancouver practice handling citizenship, permanent residence, work permits and Mandamus orders.

Joshua Slayen is the managing partner of Slayen Immigration Law, which its site describes as a 24/7 emergency firm serving individual and corporate clients worldwide. He is said to appear regularly before the Immigration and Refugee Board, its Appeal Division and the Federal Court of Canada in matters involving residency, misrepresentation, criminality and detention. Partners named include Miguel A. Martins Pereirinha and Emre Kurultay. Services range from LMIAs and spousal sponsorship to detention matters, with a second office in Abbotsford.
jsb-calgary-employment-law-calgary:
JSB Calgary Employment Law is a Calgary firm handling terminations, severance packages and constructive dismissal for employees and executives.

According to its website, the firm mainly acts for people whose employment has ended, whether with or without cause, and also works with employers on employment agreements, workplace investigations, workplace conflict and employment standards compliance. Its listed services extend to human rights complaints, discrimination and harassment, disability, maternity and other job-protected leaves, layoffs, independent contractor classification, and non-competition and non-solicitation covenants. The firm says most of its files settle out of court, and its office is on 4 Avenue SW.
jsm-law-mississauga:
JSM Law is a Mississauga firm offering civil litigation, personal injury, real estate, corporate, condominium, criminal and wills and estates services.

Its website says it acts for clients across Mississauga, Brampton, Oakville, Hamilton, Milton, Burlington, Vaughan, Markham and Scarborough. A condominium law page explains that condominium corporations exist under the Condominium Act, 1998 and describes advice on both day-to-day matters and contract arrangements. The firm says it works on contingency fee structures and that its civil litigation lawyers understand the strategies insurance companies use in injury matters.
julie-demontigny-avocate:
Julie DeMontigny Avocate practises family and youth law in Trois-Rivieres as part of the De Montigny • de Oliveira Avocates firm.

The two lawyers named on the site, Me Julie De Montigny and Me Émilie de Oliveira-Demers, practise in Trois-Rivières, Nicolet, Bécancour, Shawinigan and nearby areas, covering the judicial districts of Trois-Rivières and Saint-Maurice. Family matters include separation, divorce, child custody, access rights, support and the division of family patrimony. Youth matters include youth protection, DPJ files and adoption applications, and the firm also drafts formal demand letters.
juriseo-avocats-inc:
Juriseo Avocats is a Terrebonne firm advising entrepreneurs, executives, families and creators on commercial and corporate law.

Its site also lists civil litigation, construction and employment matters. Its website describes an approach of clarity first, strategy second and a human focus throughout, and says it combines the precision of a large firm with a team of human scale. Pages for financial services clients list insurance policy drafting, loan and credit contracts, mortgage security and representation before the AMF, while its debt recovery pages cover unpaid invoices, small-claims procedures under $15,000, and suits in the Court of Québec or Superior Court.
juriseo-avocats-rimouski:
Juriseo Avocats runs a Rimouski office on Avenue de la Cathédrale, offering civil litigation and business legal services.

The firm is presented as serving Quebec. The site lists commercial and corporate law, construction law and employment law among its practice areas, and has separate pages for financial institutions and for debt collection. For lenders and advisers it mentions insurance policies, errors and omissions cover for professionals, investment product contracts, mortgage security and priority of creditors. Its recovery work includes demand letters, bank account seizures and actions in the Court of Québec or Superior Court.
just-done-law-office-toronto:
Just Done Law Office is a Toronto firm focused on real estate transactions including home purchases, sales, title transfers and mortgage refinances.

Principal lawyer Julian Prieto practises real estate transactions and real estate litigation, says he has overseen more than $300 million in transaction volume and holds a JD from McGill University. He has represented clients at the Superior Court of Ontario and administrative tribunals. The firm says its service can be completed remotely and lists its steps, which include reviewing the agreement of purchase and sale and status certificates, checking title for liens and mortgages, advising on land transfer tax and arranging title insurance. It publishes fixed prices for each service.
justitia-cabinet-d-avocats:
Justitia Cabinet d'Avocats is a Saguenay firm in Chicoutimi handling criminal, family, youth, civil, administrative and class action matters.

The firm describes itself as multidisciplinary, made up of lawyers based in the Saguenay, and says it accompanies clients through each step of court proceedings with discretion and integrity. Its site mentions that legal aid is kept accessible when possible. Me Luc Tourangeau and Me Chantale Plante appear on its team page, and the office is on Rue Racine Est.
juzkiw-law:
Juzkiw Law is a North York firm acting in family law, criminal law and immigration, including humanitarian applications, for individuals and families.

The site lists many further matters, among them restraining orders, traffic tickets, personal injury, wills and estates, powers of attorney, employment law, notary and commissioner of oaths services, and recovery of unpaid rent after an eviction. It says its work serves Ontario's multicultural communities and that it offers service in a wide array of languages. The firm names Stefan Juzkiw among its lawyers and has its office on Yonge Street.
kahlon-law-mississauga:
Kahlon Law is a Mississauga criminal defence firm defending charges that include impaired operation and firearm possession.

The site says the firm has defended more than 500 criminal cases and publishes summaries of selected matters, among them a week-long trial that ended in dismissal, a preliminary inquiry that dismissed firearm charges, and Charter applications on arrest and right to counsel. Founder Antar Kahlon holds a criminal justice degree from the University of Guelph and a law degree from Windsor, worked with Windsor's Community Legal Aid, clerked at a Michigan district court and edited a legal journal at Windsor.
kainth-law-group-kitchener:
Kainth Law Group in Kitchener covers family, criminal, real estate, estate and business law, plus civil litigation and notary services.

Its site lists family law services for divorce, separation and child custody, criminal defence for people facing charges, and real estate law. Estate planning and powers of attorney are shown as separate services, and the firm also lists civil litigation and employment law. A notary page explains that a notary public administers oaths and affirmations, takes affidavits and witnesses signatures to deter fraud. The firm presents itself as a general practice serving Kitchener clients across several areas of law.
kalia-law-firm-brampton:
Kalia Law Firm is a Brampton practice offering family law, real estate, wills and estates, notary and independent legal advice services.

The firm says it serves Brampton and nearby communities including Mississauga, Guelph, Georgetown, Caledon and Milton. Tulika Kalia is licensed as a barrister and solicitor in Ontario and handles family and real estate matters, and she says her network of lawyers extends the firm's reach to more than four jurisdictions worldwide. The notary practice covers statutory declarations, affidavits, invitation letters, powers of attorney, name change applications and certified true copies, and the site also lists probate, travel documents and immigration services.
karapancev-law-toronto:
Karapancev Law is a Toronto criminal defence firm that acts for individuals and corporations facing criminal and regulatory charges across the GTA.

The site gives April 2022 as its founding date and names founder Alexander Karapancev with lawyers Mark O'Brien, Spase Gjorgjievski, Josh Lim, Sandy Assaad, Tharsan Logendran and Radhika Sharma. The firm says its lawyers have obtained acquittals, charge withdrawals and stays of proceedings for hundreds of clients in Toronto and the Greater Toronto Area. Its case summaries describe domestic assault trials and cross-examination of complainants, and its structured data lists Toronto, the GTA and Ontario as areas served.
kay-law-professional-corporation:
Kay Law Professional Corporation is a Kitchener boutique firm handling real estate, business, family, estate and dispute matters.

Stephen J. Kay founded the firm in 1980, and the site names lawyers James Clarke and Alexandria Nowak on its current team. merchant-law-group-llp-surrey:

merovitz-potechin-llp-ottawa:

metro-law-office:

meunier-carrier-lawyers:

mian-hakeem-law-professional-corporation:

michael-dibua-law-prof-corp-brampton:

michael-juskey-toronto:

michele-madick-law-corporation-winnipeg:

mickelson-whysall-moore-law-group:

nancy-goncalves-law-office-winnipeg:

nanda-associate-lawyers:

nanda-family-and-divorce-lawyers-mississ:

nanuq-law-victoria:

natalia-svechin-law-corporation-winnipeg:

ndiaye-enokou-avocats-gatineau:
