tapper-cuddy-llp-winnipeg:
Tapper Cuddy LLP is a Winnipeg firm focused on civil litigation, commercial law and family law, with more than 20 practice areas in total.

The firm says it has been part of Manitoba's legal landscape for almost five decades. Other areas it lists include real estate and land development, wills and estates, construction law, and employment matters and workplace investigations. Its site stresses explaining complex issues in language clients can follow and describes its clients as people it helps rather than cases. Recent news notes that Kathleen Coutts was appointed interim Integrity Commissioner for the City of Winnipeg, and that counsel Sherri Walsh became Provincial Ethics Commissioner.
tarnow-criminal-law-richmond:
Tarnow Criminal Law is a Richmond, British Columbia criminal defence firm acting for people charged with offences throughout Metro Vancouver.

Brothers David Tarnow and Jason Tarnow lead the practice, which the site describes as full-service and based on decades of combined criminal law experience. They describe themselves as trial lawyers by nature who treat guilty pleas and plea bargains as a last resort. The firm names Vancouver, Surrey and Richmond as places where it appears in court, along with the wider region of British Columbia, and its structured data also lists Yukon. Its pages emphasize Charter rights and the right to legal counsel. The office is on Westminster Highway in Richmond.
tarnowecky-law-professional-corporation: Tarnowecky Law Professional Corporation is a law practice in Kingston, Ontario, with an office on Arlington Park Place. No practice areas, lawyers or services are described for the firm in the information available for this directory. The entry therefore lists only the firm's name, its Kingston location and its street address in Suite 201 of that building.
tas-law-firm-mississauga:
TAS Law Firm is a Mississauga family law practice offering uncontested divorce, separation agreements and child custody matters on flat fees.

The firm says it serves clients across the GTA and Ontario, including Milton and Brampton, and works with clients in person and online. Its simple divorce service is aimed at spouses who agree on the terms, requires no court appearances, and includes a mobile service in the GTA. The site stresses simple flat-rate pricing without hidden fees and says it aims to keep clients informed about their rights and obligations during the divorce process.
tathgar-law:
Tathgar Law is a Victoria firm handling real estate, business and estate planning matters, with a second office in Nanaimo.

Sunny Tathgar holds a law degree with Honours from the University of Birmingham in England and a political science degree from the University of Victoria, and established his own practice after articling. The site says the firm serves clients from Victoria to Nanaimo, including Langford and Sooke. In Nanaimo and central Vancouver Island it offers wills, powers of attorney and representation agreements, residential purchases, sales and refinancing, and incorporations and commercial contracts.
taylor-law-calgary:
Taylor Law is a Calgary boutique firm handling real estate and estate planning for vendors, purchasers, mortgagors and mortgagees.

The firm says it has served Calgarians for more than thirty-four years and describes tailored legal services with personal attention for every client. Its estate planning page lists wills, enduring powers of attorney, personal directives, trusts and the appointment of trustees. On the real estate side, it advises on purchase agreements, listing agreements, leases and mortgages. Its pages are organized under real estate law and wills and estate planning, with the office located on 71 Avenue SE.
taylor-mccaffrey-llp-winnipeg:
Taylor McCaffrey LLP is a full-service Winnipeg firm acting for businesses, governments and individuals, with work extending to Manitoba, Ontario and Nunavut.

The firm was formed by the merger of firms led by Reeh Taylor and D'Arcy McCaffrey. Its website says it acts for multinational and national companies, medium and small businesses, sole proprietorships, professional associations, governments and their agencies, and individuals at different stages of life. Its structured listing names Manitoba, Ontario and Nunavut as areas served and indicates a staff of at least 60. The site also notes membership in national and international networks of law firms.
tcz-law-toronto:
TCZ Law is a Toronto family law firm handling divorce, separation, custody, support and domestic contracts, with its site offered in English and Chinese.

Lawyer Eric Tianchuan Zhao represents clients in negotiation and, when needed, in court. His website lists custody and access, child support, spousal support, division of property, marriage contracts, cohabitation agreements and motions to change. The firm says it provides a draft separation agreement or marriage contract within five business days of receiving the needed information. Before opening his own practice he worked at Baker McKenzie LLP, McInnis & Nicoll and Mahdi Leite Family Law LPP, and the firm lists downtown and North York locations.
tessera-avocats-inc:
Tessera Avocats is a Montreal boutique firm handling corporate, commercial, real estate and financing matters, along with dispute resolution. According to its website, it was founded by four lawyers whose practices complement each other.

Its service pages cover real estate and financing, corporate and commercial law, corporate reorganization, and litigation and dispute resolution. The firm describes a direct, pragmatic approach that favours clear advice and efficient execution over form, and its partners page names Yanni Sideris and Christopher Tesolin. The office is at 300 Rue Léo-Pariseau.
the-law-offices-of-nikolas-j-lust-ottawa:
Nikolas Lust runs an Ottawa criminal defence practice focused on sexual assault, domestic assault, impaired driving and drug trafficking.

Nikolas Lust says he also represents clients charged with first-degree murder, firearms offences and aggravated assault, from students to professionals. The site describes a service model built on video, telephone or in-person meetings, with documents exchanged and bills paid online, so clients can take part from home. The office is downtown at Somerset Street West, and the firm says it serves clients across Ontario. A blog series walks through the preliminary inquiry, court appearances and resolution.
the-litigators:
The Litigators is a Mississauga firm handling civil litigation, real estate, wills and estates, family and corporate law.

Its site says litigation is its default and that its civil work covers contract disputes, personal injury, professional negligence and property damage. Real estate services listed include purchases, sales, leases, financing and development. The firm describes its process as investigating a case, preparing filings, negotiating, and representing the client in court if needed, and its FAQ explains pre-litigation steps such as negotiation, mediation and arbitration.
the-myers-law-company-vancouver:
The Myers Law Company is a Vancouver criminal defence firm led by Justin Myers and Zack Myers, with traffic and family matters also listed.

According to its website, the lawyers appear in Youth Court, Provincial Court, BC Supreme Court, the Court of Appeal and the Supreme Court of Canada, and can attend in Alberta, Ontario and other jurisdictions on request. Serious matters named include murder, drug importation, firearms, theft, trafficking and arson. The firm describes its approach as detail-oriented and transparent, with lawyers who often write detailed legal arguments and who collaborate on strategy and trials without raising the cost to the client. The office is on West Pender Street.
the-riley-divorce-and-family-law-firm:
The Riley Divorce & Family Law Firm is a Hamilton-based family practice handling divorce, parenting time, spousal support and high-net-worth property division.

The site lists offices in Toronto, Ottawa, Hamilton, Kawartha Lakes and Oakville and says it serves clients throughout Ontario. It describes its clients as professionals, business owners, executives and their spouses, and mentions contested matters over parenting time, decision making, relocation, appeals and variations. The firm also produces a video series called Details in Divorce, with topics such as cross-border divorce, child support for high-income families and separation agreements set aside for non-disclosure.
thompson-dorfman-sweatman-llp-winnipeg:
Thompson Dorfman Sweatman LLP, known as TDS, is a full-service Winnipeg firm with Manitoba roots dating to 1887 and offices in Brandon and Boissevain.

The firm says two Winnipeg lawyers founded it in 1887. Its site reports access to over 30 areas of law, among them taxation, environmental law, business immigration, labour and employment, intellectual property and securities law, and membership in the Lex Mundi network of firms in over 100 countries. Its client news describes real estate work, including acquisition financing for apartment buildings and the purchase of a ten-building apartment portfolio in Winnipeg.
thomson-rogers-llp:
Thomson Rogers LLP is a Toronto firm acting in personal injury, medical malpractice, family law, expropriation, and civil, municipal and land use litigation.

The firm says it has practised for over 90 years and also uses the name TR Law. Its practice areas include personal injury, medical malpractice, family law, and municipal and expropriation law. The family law group states that it practises family law exclusively and takes an integrated team approach to complicated matters, covering marriage, cohabitation, separation and divorce. The firm's site also carries news items and a staff directory for reaching individual team members at its Bay Street office.
tierney-stauffer-llp:
Tierney Stauffer LLP is a full-service Ottawa law firm handling business, real estate, employment, estates and personal injury matters.

The firm has practised in the Ottawa area since 1982 and says it combines the insight of a boutique with the resources of a full-service firm. Within the past decade it opened offices in Cornwall, Kingston and North Bay, and it describes lawyers with over 30 years of experience in each of its practice areas. Its site also covers an articling program in which a large share of student work comes from the Civil Litigation Practice Group.
tim-louis-and-company-law-firm-vancouver:
Tim Louis & Company Law Firm is a Vancouver practice handling long-term disability claims, wills and estates, personal injury and employment law.

The firm is led by Tim Louis, who graduated from UBC Law in 1983, articled with Harry Rankin in 1984 and then opened his own practice. His site says he co-founded the BC Coalition of the Disabled, now Disability Alliance BC, and the Public Interest Advocacy Centre, and served on the Vancouver Park Board, City Council and Library Board. The firm assists clients across British Columbia with probate, estate disputes, wrongful dismissal and denied benefits, and offers service in English and Spanish.
tina-fasano-lindy-mcdonald-lawyers:
Tina Fasano & Lindy McDonald Lawyers is a Kingston firm focused on family law, with employment, wills and estates, mediation and real estate work as well.

The site names Tina Fasano, Lindy McDonald and Al Le, reports more than 30 years of combined experience in family law, and says bilingual lawyer services are offered in the Kingston area. Family work includes cohabitation agreements, marriage contracts, separation agreements, divorce, support, property, custody and access, and collaborative family law. Lindy McDonald handles employment matters such as wrongful dismissal, severance packages, human rights issues before the Human Rights Tribunal, and proceedings in Superior Court and Small Claims Court. The office is on Princess Street.
tlc-family-law-prince-george:
TLC Family Law Practice is a Prince George firm handling divorce, parenting arrangements, support and property division under British Columbia family law.

According to its website, the practice also has offices in Parksville and serves the Nanaimo and Qualicum area. Tracy L. Clark is named as a family lawyer with over 30 years in practice. The firm says its primary aim is to settle matters by agreement quickly and efficiently, while taking cases to court when that is necessary. Listed services include flat fee agreements, uncontested divorces, guardianship, parenting time and access, child and spousal support, variation of existing orders, pension and property division, family debt, and cohabitation, marriage and prenuptial agreements.
torkin-manes-llp:
Torkin Manes LLP is a full-service business and litigation law firm in downtown Toronto.

The firm says it works with high-growth companies and individuals, including owner-operators, founders, investment funds and high net worth individuals in the Canadian mid-market. Its site groups services under themes such as business matters like capital investments, M&A, real estate, cybersecurity and workplace law; family matters including separation, property division, support and parenting; disputes handled by its litigators; and a section on preserving legacy. Recent publications cover intrusion upon seclusion in Alberta and global technology law.
toronto-civil-litigation-lawyers-toronto:
Toronto Civil Litigation Lawyers, or Powell Litigation, handles commercial litigation and shareholder disputes for businesses and individuals.

The firm is led by founding partner Weston Powell and says it focuses exclusively on courtroom advocacy and dispute resolution rather than general practice. It lists commercial conflicts, real estate disputes and estate challenges, and says it appears in the Ontario Superior Court of Justice for clients across Southern Ontario. Its office is in Toronto, and structured data also names Richmond Hill among the places served, and the site states over 40 years of combined trial experience.
torys-llp:
Torys LLP is an international business law firm in Toronto advising on mergers and acquisitions and capital markets transactions.

The firm says it has worked with clients for over 80 years and describes a cross-border, multidisciplinary team led by Managing Partner Matt Cockburn. Transactions on its site include acting as counsel to Anglo American on its proposed merger with Teck Resources, to Rogers Communications on a C$7 billion equity financing with an investor group led by Blackstone, and to Ontario Power Generation on an equity investment in the Darlington New Nuclear Project, plus Endo's sale of its international pharmaceuticals business to Knight Therapeutics.
torys-llp-calgary:
Torys LLP is an international business law firm whose Calgary office, in Eighth Avenue Place East, covers energy and corporate and M&A work. The firm says it has worked in partnership with clients for over 80 years and describes a cross-border, multidisciplinary team led by Managing Partner Matt Cockburn.

Its site highlights recent matters including counsel to Anglo American on its proposed US$57 billion merger with Teck Resources, to Rogers Communications on a C$7 billion equity financing with an investor group led by Blackstone, and to Ontario Power Generation on an investment in the Darlington New Nuclear Project involving small modular reactors. It also lists work for Endo on the sale of its international pharmaceuticals business to Knight Therapeutics.
traffic-tickets-toronto-toronto:
Traffic Tickets Toronto defends drivers charged with speeding, stunt driving, careless driving and other traffic offences in Ontario and Manitoba.

The site traces the business to Shelina Lalji, who joined POINTTS in 2008, became its master franchisee in 2015 and later launched the JUSTICEJOLT Legal Defence for Drivers brand. It says the team has more than 17 years of experience and offers paralegal-led defence aimed at protecting licences, records and insurance costs. Listed services include demerit point matters, handheld device violations, dangerous driving and related criminal charges, appeals, licence reinstatement and CVOR defence for commercial operators.
travers-law-guelph:
Travers Law is a Guelph firm with a high-volume real estate, wills and estates, and business law practice across four Ontario offices.

The offices are in Kitchener-Waterloo, Cambridge, Guelph and Milton. Don Travers, called to the bar in 1974, founded the firm in 1981 under the name Paquette Travers and served on Kitchener council and Waterloo Regional Council. The site says the firm has worked in real estate law for over 40 years, offers evening appointments, remote and virtual meetings and fixed fees, and serves Waterloo, Kitchener, Cambridge, Fergus, Elora, Puslinch and Wellington County. Bryan Mayes and Robert A. Sheldon are also named, and family law is mentioned as a secondary area.
traxler-haines:
Traxler Haines is a Prince George firm handling real estate conveyancing, wills and estates, and business and corporate law since 1974.

The firm says it has six lawyers and offers services ranging from mediation to commercial contracts for residents of Prince George and surrounding communities. Its corporate law page says it advises businesses from sole proprietors to international organizations, including on investments, disputes with associates, taxes and expenses. The office is on 4th Avenue, and the site includes a page introducing each of its lawyers.
tremblay-law-group-pc-north-bay:
Tremblay Law Group PC is a North Bay firm offering real estate, corporate, litigation, family, criminal and estates law in the Nipissing area.

The firm says it offers services in English and French, with lawyers also serving Sturgeon Falls. Its history page traces the practice to 1993, when Wallace & Carr and Klein & Klein merged as Wallace Klein Partners in Law, followed by a 2024 rebrand under Managing Partner Christian Tremblay. It now lists eight legal professionals. Real estate work includes commercial and industrial transactions, conventional, high ratio and reverse mortgages, power of sale and foreclosure proceedings, and condominium registration.
treo-law-llp-brandon:
Treo Law LLP is a Brandon firm serving Western Manitoba in family law, property division, real estate, corporate matters, criminal law and child protection.

Its site names partners Breena R. Murray and Courtney A. Buckman, and associates Sundeep S. Dhillon, Lyric D. Stewart and O. Sarah Idowu. Property division is described as covering homes, farms, businesses and pensions, while real estate work covers residential, commercial and agricultural purchases and sales. The firm notes that real estate and criminal services are available in Punjabi, Hindi, Urdu, Yoruba and Nigerian Pidgin, subject to lawyer availability.
ts-canadian-immigration-services-brandon:
TS Canadian Immigration Services is a Brandon, Manitoba immigration practice assisting people who want to work, study or settle in Canada.

Its website title is framed around working, studying and immigrating to Canada, and its description mentions work permits, study visas and permanent residence applications. The practice is listed under immigration and operates from 930 Lorne Avenue in Brandon, Manitoba. The site offers little detail beyond this overview of the services it presents.
tsf-law-mississauga:
TSF Law is a Mississauga personal injury firm acting for people with denied long term disability benefits and injuries from car accidents and falls.

The firm says it practises personal injury law exclusively and acts for clients from across Ontario. Partner Terio Francis grew up in Toronto, studied at Dalhousie's Schulich School of Law, and has appeared before the Superior Court of Justice and the License Appeal Tribunal and arbitrated at the Financial Services Commission of Ontario. The team also includes associate KristoFer Angle, licensed paralegal Licia Lionessa, Andrea Seecharan and Andreea Savin, and the head office is on Traders Boulevard East.
turbide-avocat:
Turbide Avocat is a Levis business law practice handling incorporations, contracts and shareholder agreements across Quebec.

The practice says it serves entrepreneurs, small and medium-sized businesses, professionals and athletes, and offers defined legal services at displayed prices through an online client portal, with meetings held remotely or in person. Packages include federal and Quebec incorporation, shareholder agreements for two or three shareholders, and 30- or 60-minute meetings. A separate incorporation package is aimed at physicians, dentists, pharmacists, engineers, architects, accountants and other regulated professionals.
tz-law-calgary:
TZ Law is a Calgary boutique handling employment, human rights and privacy law for employees and employers across Alberta and British Columbia.

Its website covers wrongful termination, discrimination, privacy and contractual matters, and says the firm advises people on whether to accept a severance offer or sign a release. It also acts for businesses, including start-ups and entrepreneurs dealing with growth, compliance and risk. Fee options are listed as contingency, hourly and hybrid arrangements. The firm says it provides its full range of services in both English and Mandarin. Its office is on 11 Avenue SW in downtown Calgary.
unified-immigration-lawyers-toronto:
Unified Immigration Lawyers is a Toronto firm handling Canadian and U.S. immigration applications, appeals and sponsorships.

The firm was formerly known as Matkowsky Immigration Law. Its structured data gives 2017 as the founding year. The firm says it acts for individuals, families and corporations, with work ranging from Federal Court appeals and spousal sponsorship to executive work visas. It states that clients deal directly with lawyers rather than consultants or paralegals, and that it works on flat fees. Sonia Akilov is named on the site, and a step-by-step page explains how a file moves from first meeting to filing.
unified-llp-toronto:
Unified LLP is a Toronto firm handling long-term disability, family, real estate, labour and employment matters for clients across Ontario.

The firm says its offices are in Toronto and that it also serves the GTA and Kitchener. On the labour side it acts for unions, not individual grievors, in grievance arbitration, tribunals, professional regulators and courts. Its family group lists uncontested and contested divorces, separation agreements, support and parenting, with flat-fee options for straightforward matters. For disability claims, the site describes help for people whose short-term or long-term benefits are denied, delayed or cut off, and says some matters proceed on a contingency fee basis.
valin-partners-llp:
Valin Partners LLP is a full-service North Bay firm, founded in 1936, covering real estate, corporate, estates, employment, family and litigation matters.

The firm was founded by Ken Valin and Bill Flannery, and its site serves North Bay, Callander, Nipissing, Parry Sound and New Liskeard. Areas listed include residential and commercial real estate, incorporations and mergers, wills and powers of attorney, estate litigation, municipal law and construction law. Its team page names Gordon A. Prisco, Kathleen N. Klein, Andrew D. Lawson, Brianne M. Levasseur and others, and notes that several past lawyers were elevated to the bench, including Senior Regional Judge Spyros Loukidelis.
vallillee-family-lawyers-london:
Vallillee Family Lawyers is a London, Ontario boutique handling separation, divorce, parenting, support, property and Children's Aid Society matters.

The firm's website says it accepts family cases at the London and St. Thomas courthouses, including motions to change and contempt motions, and matters involving the Children's Aid Society of London & Middlesex. Services listed include separation agreements, court litigation, and Voice of the Child reports for children aged seven to fifteen, or older with special needs. Lawyer David is a Western University law graduate who also flies for the animal rescue charity Pilots4Paws. The firm describes its fees as reasonable and says it acts for parents, grandparents and other family members.
van-looyen-and-fallon-law-professional-c:
Van Looyen and Fallon is a Hamilton family law firm that also serves Brantford and surrounding areas, practising family law exclusively.

The firm is run by a wife and husband team, Emily Van Looyen and Patrick Fallon. Emily has practised family law for eight years and appears in the Ontario Court of Justice, the Superior Court of Justice and Unified Family Courts. She is a trained Collaborative Practice professional, acts as an agent for the Office of the Children's Lawyer, supervises for Pro Bono Students Canada and sits on the board of a Hamilton community agency. The team also includes a legal assistant and a law clerk, and the firm describes an organized, personal approach to each matter.
varity-law:
Varity Law is a Richmond Hill firm handling probate and estates, real estate, and corporate and commercial law for families and business owners.

The firm puts probate first, describing work for executors that includes the application, court filings and monitoring until the Certificate of Appointment is issued. It states that it does not handle estate litigation or disputes. Its team includes Sabrina Ding, an Osgoode Hall graduate whose team has closed real estate purchases, sales and refinances since 2017, and Jonathan Thibert, along with law clerks. On the business side, it advises on incorporation, contracts, buy-sell arrangements and succession, and serves clients across Ontario.
veale-law:
Veale Law is a Vancouver personal injury firm with an office on the 13th floor at 1500 West Georgia Street.

The directory lists the practice under personal injury in Vancouver, British Columbia. The firm's website did not provide readable text when this entry was prepared, so nothing further about its lawyers, services or approach is stated here.
velandia-pouyes-avocats:
Velandia & Pouyes Avocats is a criminal defence firm in Rosemere, Quebec, handling impaired driving, sexual offence, domestic violence and fraud charges. Its website, under the name VP Avocats, says the practice is concentrated on criminal law and that it supports accused people in Quebec with rigour and clarity.

The site describes four core practice areas plus an emergency path for people who have just been arrested or whose relative is detained, with round-the-clock availability. Economic offences it lists include fraud, theft, breach of trust, forged documents and money laundering, and it notes that cases in a conjugal context carry conditions from the first appearance, such as orders prohibiting communication. Release hearings are also among its listed matters. The office is on Chemin de la Grande-Côte.
veritas-avocats:
Veritas Avocats is a Laval firm focused on family law, including divorce, separation, common-law couples, child support and child custody. Its website says the lawyers keep clients informed of important developments and stay available to answer questions throughout a matter.

The firm lists civil litigation among its practice areas and describes a fair hourly rate that applies whatever the complexity of the file. It says family disputes are difficult when emotions are involved, so files are taken on quickly from the first exchange, and that transparency and communication are part of its values. The office is at 271 Rue Corbin, Suite 201.
verreau-dufresne-avocats:
Verreau Dufresne Avocats is a Levis firm serving Québec City and Lévis in civil litigation, business, family and labour law.

The firm's site offers three kinds of mandate: full handling of a lawsuit with a lean toward negotiated settlement, an a la carte supervision service for people representing themselves in court, and advice and representation where no court file exists. Its business law division works with start-up, growing and established companies in commercial and corporate matters, and the firm says many of its business lawyers have been entrepreneurs themselves.
vickers-law-group:
Vickers Law Group is an Abbotsford firm whose site title describes legal guidance in civil litigation, probate and employment throughout the Fraser Valley.

The directory also lists the firm under business law and contracts, with an office on McCallum Road in Abbotsford, British Columbia. Only a short description was available from the firm's site when this entry was prepared, so details about its lawyers, history and approach are not stated here.
vml-family-law-llp-calgary:
VML Family Law LLP is a Calgary family law firm offering divorce, custody, child support, mediation, arbitration and litigation services.

The firm says its team includes mediators, arbitrators, parenting coordinators and litigators. Listed services also include asset and debt separation, adoption, child abduction law, prenuptial agreements, legal coaching and the preparation of agreements and legal documents. Emily Varga is a co-founding partner, and the team page also names Holly McCord Lonseth, Suman Parmar, Tanisha Smith, Anne Marie Harrison, Danijela Radinovic, Caleigh Hunt, Hannah Grant and Kamiko Bosch. The firm describes a compassionate approach to emotionally charged family matters and has an office on 4 Street SW.
vrs-law-firm:
VRS Law Firm is a Kitchener firm preparing wills and powers of attorney and acting in probate and real estate matters, including for Cambridge clients.

Varun Sharma, who received his law degree from the University of New Brunswick and a BA from McMaster University, was called to the Ontario bar in 2012. The site says his real estate work covers buying, selling and refinancing for first-time purchasers through to downsizers, and that he assists lenders, investors and companies. It also names Andrew Captan, offers up-front fee quotes for real estate matters, and describes a personalized approach to estate planning, including choosing who manages affairs and who looks after children.
vsr-law-professional-corporation:
VSR Law Professional Corporation is a Mississauga firm handling real estate, personal injury, immigration, debt consolidation and notarial services.

Its real estate practice covers purchases, sales, refinancing and closings, and the site addresses clients in Kitchener, Cambridge and Brampton as well. The personal injury side describes claims arising from car accidents, bicycle accidents, dog bites, pedestrian collisions, chronic pain and psychological injury, and catastrophic injury. The firm says it acts for injured people across Ontario and that legal fees on injury claims are payable only if compensation is recovered. It also describes work on immigration matters and says it builds a case strategy from the start of each file.
wahab-law-kitchener:
Wahab Law is a Kitchener firm handling real estate, family, employment, wills and estate, and civil litigation matters.

The firm says it serves Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, the Greater Toronto Area and surrounding regions. Khaled Wahab is the managing lawyer, with Nima Pannu listed as an associate and Richard David Christy as executive advisor. Real estate work covers buying, selling and refinancing with transparent pricing, while the family practice handles custody disputes, support calculations, asset distribution and divorce. The site also lists notary services and independent legal advice, and says clients are served throughout the Waterloo Region.
walsh-llp:
Walsh LLP is a full-service Calgary firm serving Southern Alberta, with practices in agriculture, business, litigation and real estate law. The firm says it has more than sixty-five years of history across four generations and five offices: Calgary, Canmore, Okotoks, Claresholm and Stand Off.

Its practice list includes agriculture law, alternative dispute resolution, business and corporate law, civil and commercial litigation, commercial real estate, construction litigation and employment law. The agriculture group covers business structure, succession planning, banking and financing, and the site notes that several Walsh lawyers have been active farmers. Walsh says most of its work comes from long-standing clients and that it aims to give advice in plain language.
warnett-hallen-llp:
Warnett Hallen LLP is a Vancouver personal injury firm handling auto accident, slip and fall and other serious injury claims.

According to its website, the firm was founded by personal injury lawyers Paul Warnett and Manjot Hallen, and its partners each have decades of experience litigating injury claims. It says it works on a contingency fee basis, so legal fees are paid only if compensation is recovered, and that it acts for clients in Vancouver and across British Columbia. The site also carries a page on dental malpractice, along with a note that British Columbia has operated under a no-fault system for motor vehicle accidents since May 1, 2021.
waseer-law-office-london:
Waseer Law Office is a London, Ontario firm handling immigration, real estate, family law, and wills and estates for clients in seven languages.

The practice is led by Zia Waseer, who is a barrister and solicitor in Ontario and a solicitor in England and Wales. He holds a law degree from London Metropolitan University and reports over 15 years of experience with a focus on Canadian immigration law. The office is on Richmond Street in London, and many real estate and immigration matters can be handled remotely. The wills and estates practice covers wills, powers of attorney, probate and estate administration for clients in London, Windsor, Mississauga and surrounding areas.
watchmaker-law-car-accident-and-personal:
Watchmaker Law is an Edmonton firm handling car accident, personal injury and civil litigation matters for clients across Alberta.

Founder David Sowemimo represents plaintiffs in serious and catastrophic injury cases, from paraplegic and quadriplegic injuries to multi-fatality collisions, and the site says he draws on alternative dispute resolution experience. Associates Wura Oshodi and Erin Castro are also listed, and the site lists English and Yoruba. Its injury pages explain psychological injuries, fractures, traumatic brain injuries, whiplash, burns and chronic pain. The firm works on a contingency fee basis and offers flexible meeting options for clients whose injuries make travel difficult.
weaver-simmons-llp:
Weaver Simmons LLP is a Sudbury firm of more than 30 full-time lawyers handling litigation, criminal, corporate, real estate, mining and family law.

The firm describes itself as the largest law firm in Northern Ontario, with more than 90 years of service and over 60 support staff including law clerks and students. Its practice list also covers commercial, aboriginal, natural resources and labour and employment law, and it has a personal injury team. Services are offered in both official languages, Ojibwe, Greek and Italian, and clients include institutions, businesses, families and individuals throughout Ontario. The site says the firm has supported more than 60 charitable and community organizations. The office is on Brady Street in Sudbury.
weirfoulds-llp:
WeirFoulds LLP is a Toronto law firm organized around four areas: litigation, corporate, property and government law.

Its structured site data gives a founding year of 1860. The firm says fourteen of its lawyers have been appointed judges by the federal government, the first in 1883 and the most recent in 2021, and that eight of them went to courts of appeal, including the Supreme Court of Canada. Past and current lawyers have also served as Treasurers and Benchers of the Law Society of Ontario. Its news and insights pages cover employment law, construction contracts, commercial litigation and estates.
west-legal-calgary:
West Legal is a Calgary team of lawyers handling wills and estates, probate, family, employment and residential real estate matters.

The firm describes a People First approach and says it serves Calgary, Okotoks and Airdrie. David West practises in real estate, wills and probate, Kim Nutz in employment law for both employees and employers, Machelle Luiters in family law and Kelsey Morrison in wills and estate planning. Adrienne O'Reilly handles corporate, securities, mergers and acquisitions and commercial work. West Legal says it offers flat-rate fees wherever possible, including for wills, enduring powers of attorney, personal directives, probate and residential real estate transactions.
westcoast-wills-and-estates-vancouver:
Westcoast Wills & Estates is a Vancouver firm of lawyers handling wills, trusts, probate, estate disputes and related corporate and family law.

The firm lists offices in Vancouver, North Vancouver, Surrey, Burnaby and Richmond. It says 95 percent of its clients are charged flat rates, and that it donates 1 percent of its revenue to charity and tries to limit its environmental impact. Named lawyers on the team page include Jessica Poon, Aron Chitsaz, Katrina Law, Nick Russell, Harleen Sandhu and Joanna Tu. Its representative work includes helping siblings settle a parent's estate through a probate application, and its lawyers present publicly on estate topics.
what-the-law:
What The Law is an Aurora criminal defence firm founded by Mustafa Sheikh, handling impaired driving and other criminal charges at courthouses across Ontario.

The firm, styled WhatTheLaw, says it handles all criminal charges across all Ontario courthouses and offers flat-rate fees with flexible payment plans. Its site describes a large team of criminal lawyers working collaboratively, with availability around the clock. Mr. Sheikh is described as having appeared on CTV, CBC, Global News and CP24. The firm's page headings mention Richmond Hill and the wider Greater Toronto Area.
white-and-jeet-criminal-defence-calgary:
White & Jeet Criminal Defence is a Calgary team of criminal lawyers with offices in Lethbridge, Medicine Hat and Red Deer, serving all of Alberta.

The firm's website sets out practice areas that include violent and serious charges, sexual assault, murder and homicide, drug and controlled substance offences, financial and complex matters, and criminal driving offences. It also explains administration of justice offences, such as breaches of release conditions or probation under section 145 of the Criminal Code. The firm says its work runs from early investigation and bail hearings through trial, appeals and post-conviction matters, and it operates a round-the-clock help line.
white-macgillivray-lester-llp-thunder-ba:
White Macgillivray Lester LLP is a Thunder Bay personal injury firm serving clients across Northwestern Ontario.

Its site lists slip and falls, vehicle collisions, insurance disputes and long term disability among its areas of work, and describes its team as injury lawyers and agents. The firm says its lawyers and staff live in the region, unlike firms headquartered in Toronto, and that it has helped people from the Manitoba border in the west to Marathon in the east, as well as in the far northern communities. The office is at 1 Cumberland Street South, and the site names Dan Lester among its lawyers.
whitestone-law-ottawa:
Whitestone Law is an Ottawa firm providing corporate and commercial law, real estate transactions and estate planning for clients across Ontario.

The firm says it acts for businesses, individuals and families, and that clients work directly with their lawyer for continuity and clear communication. Corporate work covers mergers and acquisitions, incorporations, restructuring, contract drafting and regulatory compliance, with ongoing advisory and general counsel services available. Real estate files include buying, selling and refinancing, and estate planning centres on wills and inheritance planning. The site states that costs are explained before work starts and that every lawyer on the team is licensed in Ontario.
williams-litigation-lawyers-llp:
Williams Litigation Lawyers LLP is an Ottawa civil litigation firm covering insurance, personal injury, estate and commercial disputes.

Its site lists insurance law, personal injury, estate litigation, commercial litigation, employment litigation, professional liability and long-term disability among its areas of work. The lawyers it names include Kelly P. Hart, Eric R. Williams, Tara Lemke, Jeremy R. Rubenstein, Ashlee L. Barber, David Cutler, Gabrielle Parsons and Gabriella Gader. The firm also notes that Kelly Hart and Eric Williams were included in the 2027 edition of a peer-reviewed lawyer directory.
williams-litigation-north-north-bay:
Williams Litigation North is a North Bay civil litigation firm covering insurance, personal injury, long-term disability and professional liability.

Operating as Williams Litigation Lawyers from 176 Lakeshore Drive, the firm describes its approach as modern counsel with classic care and says it does law differently. Its site includes a French-language heading for bodily injury and a team page naming Ashlee L. Barber, Kelly P. Hart, Tara Lemke, Jeremy R. Rubenstein, Eric R. Williams, David Cutler, Gabrielle Parsons and Gabriella Gader. A news item notes that two of its lawyers were included in a Canadian lawyer ranking publication.
wishart-law-firm:
Wishart Law Firm LLP handles corporate, commercial, civil litigation, real estate and municipal law matters in Sault Ste. Marie for clients across Ontario.

The firm's history begins in 1900, when Moses and Uriah McFadden opened an office at Brock and Queen Streets. Ernest McMillan joined after Moses became a judge in 1915, and when Arthur Wishart arrived from Blind River in 1939 the firm became Wishart and McMillan. After the Second World War the practice accepted an appointment as solicitor for the city. The site also lists business planning, wills and estates and residential real estate work, and the office is on Bay Street.
witten-llp: Witten LLP is listed as an Edmonton firm with real estate and wills and estates practice tags, at 2500 Canadian Western Bank Place on Jasper Avenue. Its website did not load when this entry was compiled, so details of its lawyers, history and approach are not included. The profile is limited to the firm's name, address, city and practice areas in Alberta.
wolf-law-mississauga:
Wolf Law, based in Mississauga, advises lenders, investors and businesses on real estate transactions, commercial lending and mergers and acquisitions.

According to its website, the firm acts for purchasers, lenders, private credit funds and developers across Ontario and internationally. The lending side covers secured and unsecured arrangements such as acquisition financing, real estate development financing, bridge loans and asset-based lending. Its commercial real estate work includes acquisitions, dispositions, title searches and due diligence, and joint venture agreements for development projects. The corporate side lists share and asset purchases, joint ventures and cross-border business transactions.
wolseley-law-llp-winnipeg:
Wolseley Law LLP is a Winnipeg community law firm handling wills, estates, real estate, family, business and litigation matters. Its website says partners Gerrit Theule, Tim Brown and Leah Unruh founded the firm in the Wolseley neighbourhood, where Gerrit grew up and lives, to serve everyday issues rather than large downtown clients.

The service list includes buying, selling and mortgaging property, wills, estates and elder law, family law through collaboration, negotiation and mediation, litigation, and business and non-profit work. It also offers assisted self-representation, with unbundled services and legal coaching, and publishes flat-fee pricing for matters it finds consistent in how they progress. The office is at 120 Sherbrook Street.
woods-llp: Woods LLP is listed as a Montreal law firm with litigation and employment law as its recorded practice areas. Its office is at 2000 McGill College Avenue, Suite 1700, Montreal, Quebec. The firm's website text was not available when this entry was prepared, so details about its lawyers, courts or approach are not stated here.
wvgb-personal-injury-lawyers-ottawa:
WVGB Personal Injury Lawyers is an Ottawa firm acting for people hurt in car crashes, falls, brain injuries and other accidents.

The site describes WVGB Law Group as established in 2021 through a partnership between Villeneuve Litigation P.C. and Wolfe Lawyers P.C., serving English and French speaking communities in Ottawa and the Ottawa Valley. It says clients work directly with a partner who oversees the case personally. Practice pages cover car accidents, slip and trip and falls, brain injuries, animal attacks and rideshare and taxi accidents, along with wills and estates, and the site explains the time limits that apply to injury cases.
wyman-and-williamson-criminal-defence-la:
Wyman & Williamson is a Calgary criminal defence firm that handles only Criminal Code prosecutions, with a focus on sexual assault and impaired driving.

The firm says its lawyers act at all levels of court in Alberta, have made several appearances before the Supreme Court of Canada, and take cases throughout Western Canada. Its pages explain domestic assault matters, including the conditions police impose barring communication after a domestic incident, and cover simple and aggravated assault, threats and bail conditions. The website also describes the consequences of a sexual assault conviction, among them possible incarceration and registration on the sex offender registry. Its Calgary office sits on Seventh Avenue SW.
ylaw-vancouver:
YLaw is a Vancouver firm handling family, employment, estate litigation, immigration and strata law matters across British Columbia.

The firm lists offices in Vancouver, Langley and Chilliwack, and its site also refers to Surrey. Its family lawyers deal with divorce, common-law separation, asset and debt division, spousal and child support and parenting time, plus mediation. The employment group covers wrongful dismissal, severance, contracts and workplace equity, while estate litigators handle will disputes and unfair wills. YLaw also lists civil litigation and class actions. It says it does not treat every case as a battle and focuses on a client's long-term family, career and financial interests.
z-legal-litigation-lawyer-toronto:
Z Legal is a Toronto litigation firm handling estate, employment, commercial and family disputes and professional misconduct matters.

Founder Martin Zatovkanuk is described as a litigation lawyer with more than a decade of experience before all levels of Ontario courts. The firm says it represents clients from the outset of a matter to its end, whether it resolves by settlement, mediation, arbitration or trial. Its employment practice acts for employees and employers on wrongful dismissal, severance pay, constructive dismissal and workplace harassment across Toronto and the GTA, while other pages cover real estate litigation and will challenges. It mentions flat-rate and contingency fee options.
zacharias-mccann-llp:
Zacharias McCann LLP (ZM LLP) is an Abbotsford firm handling civil litigation, personal injury, employment, family and commercial matters.

The site says the firm acts across British Columbia, Alberta and the Yukon and lists commercial litigation, contract law, disability law, class actions, real estate, corporate law, and governance and workplace law for First Nations. Its family law team works on separation agreements, mediation, court applications and trials, alongside accountants, business valuators, real estate appraisers, pension valuators and counsellors. The firm states that its lawyers have more than 100 years of combined experience.
zaifman-immigration-lawyers-winnipeg:
Zaifman Immigration Lawyers is a Winnipeg firm handling Canadian immigration applications for individuals, employers and international students.

Kenneth Zaifman founded the firm in 1986 after taking his first immigration case, R. v. Cole, in 1979. The site describes a staff of twelve, including lawyers and Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultants, and lists service in Chinese, Spanish, Korean, Tagalog, Punjabi and Hindi. It assists applicants destined for any province under federal programs and Provincial Nominee Programs, helps Canadian employers fill labour needs, and supports students planning to study in Manitoba.
zamani-law-toronto:
Zamani Law is a Toronto criminal defence firm that represents people facing criminal allegations across the Greater Toronto Area.

Its practice areas include bail hearings and domestic violence charges, and the firm says its priority is protecting clients' rights while seeking a reasonable resolution or withdrawal of charges. For family law, wills and estate planning and real estate, it describes alliances with other practitioners to whom it directs clients, noting that family disputes are often linked to criminal proceedings. Founder Farid Zamani is a co-founder of Children without Borders, a non-profit that raises awareness of child labour and sponsors education for children in Afghan communities. The office is on Richmond Street West.
zargarian-litigation:
Zargarian Litigation is a Nanaimo criminal defence firm defending assault, sexual assault, impaired driving, firearms and fraud charges across British Columbia.

The site says Babak Zargarian and Zoe Arghandewal handle every file personally. Babak Zargarian has conducted cases at every level of court in the province and before the Supreme Court of Canada, and the firm notes that he practises in both trials and appeals. It says it serves Nanaimo, Campbell River, Courtenay, Duncan, Port Alberni and Smithers, and takes cases from Vancouver Island to Prince Rupert.
zomorodi-law-pc-richmond-hill:
Zomorodi Law PC is a Richmond Hill firm offering real estate transactions, business law, civil and commercial litigation, and wills and estates.

Its real estate practice covers purchase, sale and mortgage closings for urban and cottage properties, condominiums and vacant land, both residential and commercial. Business services include articles of incorporation, shareholder agreements and the sale or acquisition of franchised businesses, and notary public services are also listed. The site names newcomers, business owners, young entrepreneurs, other professionals, international investors and diverse communities among the groups it serves, and says its litigation experience lets it handle disputes that arise during a closing in house.
zoom-law-calgary:
Zoom Law is a Calgary firm practising only injury law, from car accidents and hit and runs to motorcycle, pedestrian and cycling crashes.

Its car accident work covers rear-end collisions, impaired or distracted driving, uninsured motorists and wrongful death. The firm says it works across Alberta and offers service in several languages, and its structured data lists English, Arabic, Russian, Polish, Ukrainian, Tagalog, Urdu, Punjabi, Hindi and Kurdish. Its pages describe guidance through chronic injury matters and recovery, with the Calgary office as its base.
zubic-law:
Zubic Law is a Niagara Falls firm handling residential and commercial real estate, corporate matters, wills, powers of attorney and probate.

Its website explains that Zubic Law Professional Corporation and Anya Zubic Professional Law Corporation both operate under the Zubic Law name. Real estate services described include contract negotiation, due diligence and closings for buyers and sellers, as well as mortgage refinancing, and the site has separate real estate pages for Welland, St. Catharines, Airdrie and Okotoks. On the estates side, it describes guiding executors and beneficiaries through probate and estate administration. The office is on Victoria Avenue in Niagara Falls.
